tutorial.step0_body: There's a new letter in the mailbox. Open it.
tutorial.step1_body: The commission in your mailbox asks for a pour-over. Make one at the stove — that's your start.
tutorial.step2_body: Finish this letter and the grocer opens up, with more to buy.
tutorial.step3_body: The order board is open. Cook what it asks for, then hand it over.

settings.title: Settings
settings.no_music: No background music yet — drop a track into assets/audio/music/ and it will be picked up.
settings.save_path: Location: {0} (autosaved every 20 s and on window close; a .bak copy is kept)
settings.reset_hint: Deletes the save and clears this run. Cannot be undone.
settings.reset_armed: After this, the room goes back to how it started.
settings.about_hint: Engine, framework, sounds and fonts — credits and licenses are all there.
settings.shortcuts: Shortcuts: C Stove · R Research · V Catalog · F Equipment · M Merchant · L Mailbox · O Settings · Esc Back
settings.debug_hint: In the normal flow, offline production waits for the 16th letter. This only shows up in debug builds, to see what the summary looks like.
settings.debug_done: Unlocked. Close the game and reopen to see the offline summary.
settings.research_guide_hint: The research desk shows a three-step guide the first time you open it. Press the button below to make it show up again next time.
settings.research_guide_button: Show the guide again next time
settings.research_guide_done: Right — it will show up the next time you open the research desk.

hud.catalog_tooltip: Open the catalog and see what is newly recorded
hud.mail_tooltip: Open the mailbox: letters and to-dos both live here
hud.clock_playtime_tooltip: Play time · click for the real clock
hud.clock_realtime_tooltip: Real time · click for play time

facility.title: Equipment
facility.subtitle: The smoother the gear, the shorter the wait.
facility.kitchen_lanes: Lv.{0}: {1} line(s); expanding to Lv.{2} gives {3}.
facility.kitchen_parallel_hint: How many batches a station runs side by side depends on its own level.
facility.kitchen_maxed: The kitchen is as big as it gets.
facility.warehouse_body: Lv.{0} · common ingredients up to {1}, rare up to {2}.
facility.research_body: Put two ingredients together and see if something new comes out.
facility.orders_body: {0} / {1} orders posted; can grow to {2}. Expand it from the order board.

mail.title: Mailbox
mail.subtitle: No sender on the envelope — only the date.
mail.waiting_catalog: The next one waits until the catalog holds {0} entries.
mail.waiting_craft: The next one comes after you make {0}.
mail.waiting_task: The next one comes after you finish what is on your hands.
mail.waiting_task_hand_in: Finish the errand in "{0}" first; then the next one arrives.
mail.waiting_letter: The next one comes after you read the letter in your hands.
mail.waiting_other: The next one comes after you go one step further.
mail.waiting_catalog_remaining: The next one waits until the catalog holds {0} entries ({1} to go).
mail.waiting_letter_catalog: After reading "{0}", the catalog must reach {1} entries ({2} to go).
mail.empty_todo: Nothing taken on yet. Some letters will ask you to lend a hand.
mail.task_hint: This one only asks for {0} — don't spend extra on anything else.

letter.offline_unlocked: (While you're away, things will start growing here on their own.)
letter.task_heading: Another sheet is folded in with the letter
letter.task_accepted_hint: Added to your to-do list — third tab of the mailbox.
letter.task_craft_theme: Make {1} dishes from "{0}", then come back to confirm
letter.task_craft_tag: Make {1} dishes tagged "{0}", then come back to confirm
letter.handwriting_unknown: The handwriting is unfamiliar, not anyone who lives on this truck.
letter.handwriting_familiar: The handwriting looks familiar, though I cannot place it.
letter.handwriting_own: It is my own hand. I do not remember writing it.

merchant.title: Grocer
merchant.subtitle: "Take these and cook something — better than sitting in my stall."
merchant.empty_owned: Nothing in hand to sell yet — switch to "All".
merchant.empty_sell: Nothing to buy back right now.
merchant.level_hint: The more he can get, the wider the shelves and the quicker the refill.
merchant.level_max: There is nothing more he can bring in.

warehouse.title: Pantry
warehouse.subtitle: "Count what you have first — then we'll talk about selling."
warehouse.sell_armed: Click again to sell the whole stack.
warehouse.empty_material: Nothing in the pantry yet. Knock on the crate by the door, or see the merchant.
warehouse.empty_food: No dishes made yet. The stove is hot — go cook one.
warehouse.capacity_hint: Caps only limit what a source piles up on its own. Bought, cooked, and mailed goods ignore them.

order.title: Order board
order.subtitle: "Passers-by write down what they want and hand it through the window. I cook it, they pay."
order.full: The board is full. Hand one in and the next will come.
order.empty: No orders yet. Unlock a dish and the customers will know what to ask for.
order.refresh_wait: Just swapped — give it a moment.

craft.title: Stove
craft.subtitle: The pot will tell you if you have enough.
craft.pick: Pick something on the left to make.
craft.pick_craftable: Switch to "All" to see what each dish is missing; materials usually come from the box outside or the merchant.
craft.cant_craft: Not enough materials, or no free hands.
craft.lane_busy: All lines are busy — wait for one to finish.
craft.empty_result: Nothing comes through with these filters. Try another word, or loosen them.

filter.group_tip: How to split this page into groups
filter.sort_tip: What order to lay this page out in
filter.empty: Nothing matches these filters. Try another word, or loosen them.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Flavors written down stay here.
catalog.locate_failed: Couldn't find that new entry; staying on this page.
catalog.hint_research_try: Not figured out yet. Put {0} together at the research desk and try.
catalog.progress_early: Just opened. A few more entries and a letter will arrive.
catalog.progress_quarter: Still a long way to go. A few more entries and a letter will arrive.
catalog.progress_half: Past halfway. A few more entries and a letter will arrive.
catalog.progress_near: Almost there. A few more entries and a letter will arrive.
catalog.hint_facility: Not sure how to use it yet.
catalog.first_meet: The page fills in the first time you meet it.
catalog.fact_harvest_cap: Full at {0}; buy or craft beyond that
catalog.hint_material_base: Picked up along the way — leave it and it comes.
catalog.hint_material_semi: A semi-finished thing you made yourself.
catalog.hint_material_buy: The merchant has it — {0} coins each.
catalog.hint_material_harvest: You can get it from the {0}.
catalog.hint_material_harvest_locked: The {0} must reach Lv.{1} to gather it (now Lv.{2}).
catalog.hint_material_harvest_unopened: Gatherable at the {0} once it opens.
catalog.hint_material_unknown: Not seen yet — keep an eye out.

research.title: Research desk
research.subtitle: Trying costs a little of what you burn, but one success is written down for good.
research.all_known: Nothing left to figure out — everything on the stove is known.
research.no_candidates: No combinations to try right now. Cook or unlock more recipes — new leads will follow.
research.upgrade_hint: Less waste, more sets at once
research.pick_hint: Click to put in a slot
research.desk_busy: The desk is busy — wait or take one back.
research.records_empty: Combinations you try are written down here — retrying costs nothing.
research.started: Set on the desk — wait for the result.
research.cant_start: Can't put it in — materials, slots or the candidate pool aren't right.
research.desc_untried: That combination hasn't been tried yet.
research.desc_heat: Wrong heat: {0} needs at least Lv.{1}.
research.desc_heat_ready: Heat is enough: {0} is now Lv.{1} — you can try again.
research.cost_hint: Each pick costs 1; half a chance it costs 2.
research.usage_hint: {0} more directions to try — pick 2–4 items into the slots, then “Try”.
research.empty_hint: Cook a few more dishes and record more of the catalog — new directions will surface.
research.guide_step_1: 1. On “Candidates”, click 2–4 ingredients — they drop into the desk slots.
research.guide_step_2: 2. Press “Try”: the ingredients are spent, and a match teaches you the recipe.
research.guide_step_3: 3. A miss burns a little; results go to “Records”, and retrying the same set costs nothing.
research.history_tuition: Everything in the slots counts as tuition.

table.caption: In progress and just finished
table.empty_hint: The stove is still warm — go make something.

toast.merchant_locked: The grocer isn't open yet — read that letter first.
toast.orders_locked: The order board opens after the letter before you leave.

africa.name: Africa
africa.desc: A sturdy staple beside a pot of stew.

americas.name: Americas
americas.desc: From grilled meat to corn, portions are honest.

base.name: Home Cooking
base.desc: Everyday food without a region: a coffee, a pastry, a simple meal.

cafe.name: Cafe Menu
cafe.desc: The shop menu: coffee, pastries, and a seat in the afternoon.

east_asia.name: East Asian Table
east_asia.desc: Home-style dishes built on rice and noodles — steamed, stir-fried, boiled, braised.

fast_food.name: Fast Food
fast_food.desc: Wrapped in paper, eaten standing up.

mediterranean.name: Mediterranean
mediterranean.desc: Olive oil, tomatoes, and a lot of sun.

middle_east.name: Middle East & Central Asia
middle_east.desc: Spices and a slow fire; the lid lifts and it smells.

south_asia.name: South Asia
south_asia.desc: Spices layered in, thickening as it cooks.

southeast_asia.name: Southeast Asia
southeast_asia.desc: Sour, hot, coconut — one bite wakes you.

western.name: Western Classics
western.desc: Knife and fork laid out, taken slowly.

breakfast.name: Breakfast
breakfast.desc: Early light, something before the day.

festival.name: Celebration
festival.desc: The kind worth making only when there is someone to share it with.

home.name: Home Cooking
home.desc: The everyday kind: plain ingredients, no fuss.

late_night.name: Late Night
late_night.desc: Lights off, still wanting one more bite.

soup.name: Soup & Broth
soup.desc: The bowl is hot; the spoon goes first.

spicy.name: Spicy
spicy.desc: The heat comes up behind the tongue.

street.name: Street & Late Night
street.desc: Something you can carry away, or want only after dark.

sweet.name: Sweets & Drinks
sweet.desc: Sweet, cold, or sipped slowly out of a cup.

vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
vegetarian.desc: No meat, and it does not feel missing.

veg.name: Vegetables
veg.desc: "Any vegetable" — use what is in the basket.

fruit.name: Fruit
fruit.desc: "Any fruit" — sweet or sour, both count.

pantry.name: Pantry
pantry.desc: The everyday shelf: salt, sugar, flour, oil, coffee beans.

livestock.name: Livestock
livestock.desc: Any meat, egg or dairy from the ranch — use whatever it gives you.

chocolate.name: Chocolate
chocolate.desc: "Any kind of chocolate" — dark or milk chocolate both count.

coffee_machine.name: Coffee Machine
coffee_machine.desc: Press the button and it stays silent for a second first.

grinder.name: Grinder
grinder.desc: It wobbles a little when it spins.

oven.name: Oven
oven.desc: The glass in the door is always a little fogged.

pan.name: Frying Pan
pan.desc: A thin film of oil on the bottom; the rim has been scorched black.

research_desk.name: Research Desk
research_desk.desc: A corner of the desk: a polished wooden tray and a few empty bowls.

steamer.name: Steamer
steamer.desc: Lift the lid and the steam rushes out first, and nothing is clear.

stove.name: Stove
stove.desc: Turn the flame down and the pot goes quiet.

fridge.name: Fridge
fridge.desc: A humming steel box, colder inside than out.

warehouse.name: Pantry
warehouse.desc: The shelves in the corner. How much they hold depends on how high they go.

eggplant.name: Eggplant
eggplant.desc: Glossy purple skin; pale, soft flesh inside.

cassava.name: Cassava
cassava.desc: Rough skin; snow-white flesh once peeled.

roasted_eggplant.taste: Charred skin and soy, soft enough to pull apart with chopsticks.
roasted_eggplant.hint: Roast whole until the skin wrinkles, then split and top.
roasted_eggplant.name: Roasted Eggplant
roasted_eggplant.desc: Roast the eggplant soft, split it open, cover with spice and soy, and return to the oven until glossy.

eggplant_parmesan.taste: Cheese pulls; the eggplant has drunk the tomato.
eggplant_parmesan.hint: Fry the slices first so they do not weep.
eggplant_parmesan.name: Eggplant Parmesan
eggplant_parmesan.desc: Fry eggplant slices, layer with tomato and cheese, and bake until bubbling.

cassava_fries.hint: Parboil the cut cassava before frying.
cassava_fries.name: Cassava Fries
cassava_fries.desc: Cut cassava into batons, parboil, drain, fry golden and salt.

cassava_cake.taste: Soft and chewy; coconut outruns the sugar.
cassava_cake.hint: Grate the cassava fine and stir the coconut milk smooth.
cassava_cake.name: Cassava Cake
cassava_cake.desc: Grate cassava into a batter with coconut milk and sugar, then steam until set.

americano.taste: Bitter and clean, like wiping the morning once with a cloth.
americano.hint: What's left after hot water runs through an espresso.
americano.name: Americano
americano.desc: One espresso, one pour of water. Too simple to wait for, too simple to get wrong.

apple_crumble.name: Apple Crumble
apple_crumble.desc: Apples below, buttered dough crumbled over, baked gold.

apple_pie.taste: The rim is flakier; the middle is soft.
apple_pie.hint: Cook the water out of the apples so the filling holds.
apple_pie.name: Apple Pie
apple_pie.desc: Soften apples with sugar, wrap in dough, bake until golden.

arancini.taste: Cheese runs out at the first bite.
arancini.hint: Cool the rice or the balls fall apart.
arancini.name: Arancini
arancini.desc: Wrap cold rice around cheese, shape, fry golden.

asado.hint: Coarse salt, only before it hits the fire.
asado.name: Asado
asado.desc: Oil and salt a whole cut, roast slow until charred and pink.

avocado_toast.taste: The green layer is not quite flat.
avocado_toast.hint: Toast it crisp so it does not sag.
avocado_toast.name: Veggie Mash Toast
avocado_toast.desc: Toast the slice, crush greens over it, finish with oil.

baba_ganoush.name: Baba Ganoush
baba_ganoush.desc: Roast the eggplant until the skin shrivels, scoop the flesh, mash with oil and spice.

bagel.taste: A chewy skin, a tight crumb.
bagel.hint: Boil before baking for the shine.
bagel.name: Bagel
bagel.desc: Shape rings, boil them briefly, then bake.

bagel_sandwich.taste: Split bagel, cheese spread to the edge.
bagel_sandwich.name: Bagel Sandwich
bagel_sandwich.desc: Split the bagel, spread cream cheese, tuck in greens.

baklava.taste: It shatters at a bite; syrup on your fingers.
baklava.hint: Syrup after baking keeps it crisp.
baklava.name: Baklava
baklava.desc: Layer pastry with nuts, bake gold, then pour syrup.

banana_rice.taste: Sweet, but the side is salt.
banana_rice.name: Banana Rice
banana_rice.desc: Cook rice in coconut milk, serve with ripe banana.

banh_mi.taste: The crust cracks; the inside is packed.
banh_mi.hint: Toast the roll so the shell sings.
banh_mi.name: Banh Mi
banh_mi.desc: Crisp the baguette, fill with meat and greens, sauce.

beef_bourguignon.taste: The meat gives way; the sauce coats the spoon.
beef_bourguignon.hint: Low heat, lid on, no peeking.
beef_bourguignon.name: Slow-Braised Beef
beef_bourguignon.desc: Brown the beef, dust with flour, add vegetables and spice, stew gently.

beef_wellington.taste: Pink inside, the pastry in layers.
beef_wellington.hint: Wrap it tight or the pastry opens.
beef_wellington.name: Beef Wellington
beef_wellington.desc: Sear the meat, coat with mushroom, wrap in dough, brush egg, bake.

bibimbap.hint: A runny yolk loosens the whole bowl.
bibimbap.name: Bibimbap
bibimbap.desc: Rice under greens, meat and a fried egg; mix with chilli sauce.

biryani.name: Biryani
biryani.desc: Layer rice and meat, scatter nuts, steam until it takes the spice.

blt.taste: Bacon fat soaking in, tomato still cool.
blt.name: BLT
blt.desc: Bacon, lettuce, tomato. The name is the recipe.

boerewors.taste: Thick, and it bleeds juice when cut.
boerewors.hint: Do not prick it or the juice goes.
boerewors.name: Boerewors
boerewors.desc: Season minced meat, stuff, fry until the skin catches.

boiled_egg.hint: Six minutes for a runny yolk, ten for set.
boiled_egg.name: Boiled Egg
boiled_egg.desc: Egg in cold water, time from the boil. Peel slowly.

braised_egg.taste: The white has gone brown; the salt arrives at the end.
braised_egg.hint: Crack the shells before they soak.
braised_egg.name: Braised Egg
braised_egg.desc: Boil the eggs, crack them, simmer in soy and spice.

brownie.hint: Underbake a little; a crumb on the skewer is enough.
brownie.name: Brownie
brownie.desc: Melt butter and sugar, fold in egg, flour and chocolate, bake till the top crusts.

buffalo_wings.taste: Sauce to the knuckles, and the heat builds.
buffalo_wings.hint: Butter in the sauce makes it cling.
buffalo_wings.name: Buffalo Wings
buffalo_wings.desc: Bake the meat crisp, toss in chilli and butter.

bun.taste: The wrapper drinks the juices; better than the filling.
bun.name: Steamed Bun
bun.desc: Risen dough wrapped around pork, seam up, steamed until the skin turns translucent.

burrito.taste: Rolled tight; cut it and the layers show.
burrito.hint: Fold the ends in or it leaks.
burrito.name: Burrito
burrito.desc: Fill a corn tortilla with meat, greens and cheese, roll, then griddle.

butter_rice.taste: Butter melting in, soy only at the rim.
butter_rice.name: Butter Rice
butter_rice.desc: A well in hot rice, a pat of butter, soy around the edge. Look before you stir.

butter_toast.taste: Butter melts into the crumb, the edge stays crisp.
butter_toast.hint: Spread while hot, all the way to the corners.
butter_toast.name: Butter Toast
butter_toast.desc: Toast it, butter it while warm. That melting layer is the point.

caesar_salad.taste: The croutons still crunch; the dressing coats evenly.
caesar_salad.hint: Add the bread last or it softens.
caesar_salad.name: Caesar Salad
caesar_salad.desc: Tear the leaves, toss in dressing, scatter bread cubes and cheese.

cake.taste: The weight of butter pins the sweetness down.
cake.hint: The one that takes the longest.
cake.name: Cake
cake.desc: Pour the batter into the tin and let it rise.

candied_fruit.taste: The sugar shell cracks at one bite.
candied_fruit.hint: Dip at the small bubbles or it sticks to your teeth.
candied_fruit.name: Candied Fruit
candied_fruit.desc: Skewer the fruit, dip in hot sugar, let it set.

cappuccino.taste: Sweet first, bitter after; the foam lies on top like a light thing.
cappuccino.hint: Its name wears a little hat; drinking it is like a sweet cloud.
cappuccino.name: Cappuccino
cappuccino.desc: Milk beaten up: the sweet floats to the top and the bitter stays below.

caprese.name: Caprese
caprese.desc: Slice tomato and cheese, overlap them, add spice.

caramel_macchiato.taste: The syrup at the bottom stays; the last sip is sweetest.
caramel_macchiato.hint: Do not stir; the layers are the point.
caramel_macchiato.name: Caramel Macchiato
caramel_macchiato.desc: Syrup in the glass, milk and espresso over it, a caramel streak on top.

carrot_cake.taste: You cannot taste the carrot, only see it.
carrot_cake.hint: Grate it fine or the crumb turns tough.
carrot_cake.name: Carrot Cake
carrot_cake.desc: Fold grated carrot into the batter, bake until a skewer comes clean.

ceviche.hint: Do not leave it long or it falls apart.
ceviche.name: Ceviche
ceviche.desc: Cure fish slices in fruit juice until opaque, season.

chai.taste: Spice hits first; milk follows behind.
chai.hint: Pull it just before the boil.
chai.name: Chai
chai.desc: Milk with tea leaves, spice and sugar, simmered until it darkens.

cheese_stick.taste: Crisp out, a long pull inside.
cheese_stick.name: Cheese Sticks
cheese_stick.desc: Cheese in sticks, battered, fried gold. Eat them hot.

cheese_toast.taste: The cheese puffs, then browns at the edge.
cheese_toast.hint: Top heat, and don't walk away.
cheese_toast.name: Cheese Toast
cheese_toast.desc: Toast under a blanket of cheese until it collapses. The pull is the best part.

cheeseburger.taste: Cheese melted over the patty, pulling in strings.
cheeseburger.hint: Cheese in the last ten seconds, no longer.
cheeseburger.name: Cheeseburger
cheeseburger.desc: Lay a slice of cheese on the near-done patty and cover it to melt.

cheesecake.taste: Cool in the middle, browned at the rim.
cheesecake.hint: Do not cut while warm; a night in the cold sets it.
cheesecake.name: Cheesecake
cheesecake.desc: Fold cream cheese and sugar through the batter, pour into a tin, bake until the edge sets.

chicken_curry.hint: Fry the spice before the meat.
chicken_curry.name: Chicken Curry
chicken_curry.desc: Fry spice, add meat, simmer with milk until thick.

chicken_wrap.taste: Rolled a bit loose; a bite drops filling.
chicken_wrap.hint: Warm the flatbread first so it folds without cracking.
chicken_wrap.name: Chicken Wrap
chicken_wrap.desc: Fry and slice the meat, roll it with greens in a flatbread.

cinnamon_roll.taste: Sugar pooled in the folds; it opens in a spiral.
cinnamon_roll.hint: Roll it thin for more layers.
cinnamon_roll.name: Cinnamon Roll
cinnamon_roll.desc: Roll the dough, spread butter, sugar and cinnamon, slice and bake.

clear_noodle_soup.hint: Boil the noodles apart or the soup clouds.
clear_noodle_soup.name: Clear Noodle Soup
clear_noodle_soup.desc: Noodles into the bowl, clear stock over. A little scallion is enough.

club_sandwich.taste: Three layers, held by a pick.
club_sandwich.hint: Keep each layer thin so it bites clean.
club_sandwich.name: Club Sandwich
club_sandwich.desc: Toast the bread, stack meat, egg and greens, cut into triangles.

coconut_dessert.hint: Do not stir hard or it foams.
coconut_dessert.name: Coconut Dessert
coconut_dessert.desc: Reduce coconut milk with sugar, add fruit, chill.

cold_brew.hint: Takes a long time, but no fire.
cold_brew.name: Cold Brew
cold_brew.desc: Coffee grounds steep in cold water in the fridge all afternoon before the flavor comes out.

con_panna.taste: Cream first, then espresso -- no transition in between.
con_panna.hint: Cream on top of the shot; don't stir.
con_panna.name: Con Panna
con_panna.desc: A small shot under a cloud of cream, a blanket for something bitter.

cookie.taste: A little burnt at the edge, still soft in the middle.
cookie.hint: A small round slice, sweet without detour.
cookie.name: Cookie
cookie.desc: Spread into thin rounds: the edges brown before the middle has time.

corn_soup.hint: Hold back half the corn for the end.
corn_soup.name: Corn Chowder
corn_soup.desc: Corn and milk blended, brought to a boil, a few whole kernels on top.

corn_tortilla.taste: Charred at the edge, sweet corn through the middle.
corn_tortilla.name: Corn Tortilla
corn_tortilla.desc: Corn and flour kneaded into a dough, rolled thin, toasted in a pan until it blisters.

couscous.name: Couscous
couscous.desc: Rub flour into grains, steam, toss with vegetables and spice.

cream_puff.taste: Hollow at first bite, then the cream.
cream_puff.hint: Bake the shell hollow, then fill it.
cream_puff.name: Cream Puff
cream_puff.desc: The shell puffs up; once cool, cream goes in from the bottom.

creamed_spinach.taste: Dark in colour, mild in taste.
creamed_spinach.name: Creamed Spinach
creamed_spinach.desc: Blanch and squeeze the spinach, chop, fold into white sauce and butter.

creamy_mushroom_chicken.taste: Thick sauce, mushrooms still a little firm.
creamy_mushroom_chicken.hint: Fry the mushrooms apart first and pour off the water.
creamy_mushroom_chicken.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
creamy_mushroom_chicken.desc: Brown the chicken, fry the mushrooms, add white sauce and reduce.

creme_brulee.taste: Caramel on top; you have to break it.
creme_brulee.hint: Egg, cream, sugar -- then burn the sugar.
creme_brulee.name: Creme Brulee
creme_brulee.desc: Baked until set, dusted with sugar, torched into a thin shell.

croissant.taste: Layer after layer; your fingers shine when you're done.
croissant.hint: The first thing into the oven, and it sheds crumbs.
croissant.name: Croissant
croissant.desc: Dough folded over butter, folded a few times, and the layers come out of the oven.

curry_puff.name: Curry Puff
curry_puff.desc: Wrap curry filling in pastry, bake until flaky.

curry_rice.hint: Fry the spice first to wake it.
curry_rice.name: Curry Rice
curry_rice.desc: Fry meat and vegetables, add spice and water, thicken, pour over rice.

dal.taste: Thick enough to hold a spoon.
dal.name: Dal
dal.desc: Boil the beans until they break down, then season.

dumpling.taste: Thin skin, the green showing through.
dumpling.hint: Work the filling or it falls apart.
dumpling.name: Dumplings
dumpling.desc: Roll wrappers, fold in meat filling, steam.

egg_drop_soup.hint: Boiling stock, a thin stream of egg, no stirring.
egg_drop_soup.name: Egg Drop Soup
egg_drop_soup.desc: Stock at a rolling boil, egg poured in a thread. Leave it alone.

egg_pancake.taste: Crisp at the rim, soft in the middle.
egg_pancake.name: Egg Pancake
egg_pancake.desc: Whisk egg and flour, pour thin into a pan, fry both sides.

egg_roll.taste: Layers inside, milk at the end.
egg_roll.hint: Spread it thin or it cracks when rolled.
egg_roll.name: Egg Roll
egg_roll.desc: Egg and milk, spread thin, rolled into spirals and sliced.

egg_salad.taste: Yolk and dressing together, white in chunks.
egg_salad.hint: Boil them hard for easier crushing.
egg_salad.name: Egg Salad
egg_salad.desc: Crushed egg and dressing. On bread or beside lettuce.

egg_salad_sandwich.taste: Soft filling squeezing out of the cut.
egg_salad_sandwich.hint: Crush the egg, don't dice it.
egg_salad_sandwich.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
egg_salad_sandwich.desc: Crushed egg and dressing between toast. Better after a rest in the cold.

egg_tart.taste: Crisp at the rim, trembling in the middle.
egg_tart.hint: Custard poured into a dough cup.
egg_tart.name: Egg Tart
egg_tart.desc: Dough pressed into little cups, custard poured in, baked until a skin forms.

egg_toast.taste: Bite down and the yolk runs.
egg_toast.name: Egg Toast
egg_toast.desc: Buttered toast, fried egg on top. Your fingers will catch some yolk.

espresso.taste: Bitter enough to shine, leaving only a little at the bottom of the cup.
espresso.hint: Coffee grounds run once through hot water; this is the little part that comes out.
espresso.name: Espresso
espresso.desc: The base of every coffee. It is also a finished thing you can dilute with water or milk.

falafel.hint: Soak, do not boil, then grind.
falafel.name: Falafel
falafel.desc: Soak and grind the beans, bind with flour, fry into balls.

farinata.taste: Thin, crisp at the edge, soft in the middle.
farinata.name: Farinata
farinata.desc: Whisk flour and water thin, pour in a tray, oil and bake.

feijoada.taste: Dark and salty, made for rice.
feijoada.hint: Stew until the beans go to sand.
feijoada.name: Feijoada
feijoada.desc: Slow-cook meat and beans with spice until the broth thickens.

fish_and_chips.hint: Keep the oil hot or it drinks oil.
fish_and_chips.name: Fish & Chips
fish_and_chips.desc: Coat the seafood, fry until it puffs, serve beside fries.

flat_white.taste: Stronger than a latte; the milk just holds the bitterness down.
flat_white.hint: Two shots, one part milk, no sugar.
flat_white.name: Flat White
flat_white.desc: Less milk, so the coffee steps forward.

focaccia.hint: Press with your fingers, not through.
focaccia.name: Focaccia
focaccia.desc: Spread the dough, dimple it, oil and spice, then bake.

french_omelette.name: French Omelette
french_omelette.desc: Beat the eggs, melt butter, push into a roll over low heat.

french_onion_soup.taste: The onions taste sweet, not like onions.
french_onion_soup.hint: Fry them to deep brown; do not hurry.
french_onion_soup.name: French Onion Soup
french_onion_soup.desc: Caramelise sliced onions, add stock, top with bread and cheese, grill.

french_toast.hint: Soak it through, don't just dip.
french_toast.name: French Toast
french_toast.desc: Bread through egg and milk, fried on both sides. Cut it open: wet in the middle.

fresh_milk.taste: A white film on the glass.
fresh_milk.hint: Serve cold; do not heat it.
fresh_milk.name: Fresh Milk

fried_chicken.taste: The crust makes a sound; the inside still burns.
fried_chicken.hint: Spice in the batter beats spice on top.
fried_chicken.name: Fried Chicken
fried_chicken.desc: Coat the meat, fry till gold, lift and drain.

fried_dough.name: Fried Dough
fried_dough.desc: Let the dough rise, tear into pieces, fry golden.

fried_egg.taste: Crisp at the edge, still soft in the middle.
fried_egg.name: Fried Egg
fried_egg.desc: A little oil, an egg, and patience until the edge curls.

fried_noodles.taste: All wok smoke; the strands break short.
fried_noodles.hint: Parboil first or it turns to mush.
fried_noodles.name: Fried Noodles
fried_noodles.desc: Half-cook the noodles, then fry hard with greens.

fried_rice.taste: Every grain separate, the wok very hot.
fried_rice.hint: Rice, egg, vegetable -- high heat, quick.
fried_rice.name: Fried Rice
fried_rice.desc: Day-old rice is best; scramble the egg first, then toss it all.

fries.taste: Salt still clinging, edges a little soft.
fries.hint: Soak the cut strips; they fry crisper.
fries.name: Fries
fries.desc: Cut the potatoes, soak off the starch, fry until the edges brown.

fruit_salad.taste: Cut unevenly, the cream beginning to loosen.
fruit_salad.hint: Chill the fruit before folding in cream.
fruit_salad.name: Fruit Salad
fruit_salad.desc: Cube the fruit, fold in cream, chill a while.

fufu.taste: A single ball, eaten with the fingers.
fufu.hint: Pound it hot; cold it sets.
fufu.name: Fufu
fufu.desc: Boil the cassava, pound it hot into a ball.

garlic_toast.hint: Crush the garlic, don't dice it.
garlic_toast.name: Garlic Toast
garlic_toast.desc: Soft butter, crushed garlic, spice. Spread and bake until the edge browns.

gazpacho.taste: Served cold, and only then does it taste of summer.
gazpacho.name: Gazpacho
gazpacho.desc: Blend tomato with oil, then chill.

greek_salad.taste: A slab of cheese on top, the oil bright.
greek_salad.hint: Toss gently or it waters out.
greek_salad.name: Greek Salad
greek_salad.desc: Chop the vegetables, top with cheese, oil and spice.

green_curry.taste: Green, but the heat is warm.
green_curry.hint: Crack the coconut milk before the paste.
green_curry.name: Green Curry
green_curry.desc: Boil coconut milk, add spice and meat, reduce until thick.

green_papaya_salad.taste: Sour and hot, and it crunches.
green_papaya_salad.hint: Pound lightly; it should not mash.
green_papaya_salad.name: Shredded Veggie Salad
green_papaya_salad.desc: Shred the greens, pound with spice, scatter nuts.

grilled_cheese.taste: A crisp shell out, a pull inside.
grilled_cheese.name: Grilled Cheese
grilled_cheese.desc: Toast and cheese, buttered outside, fried gold. Cut while hot.

groundnut_stew.hint: Stir the nut paste in last or it splits.
groundnut_stew.name: Groundnut Stew
groundnut_stew.desc: Stew meat and greens soft, then stir in nut paste.

ham_cheese_sandwich.name: Ham & Cheese Sandwich
ham_cheese_sandwich.desc: Two slices, ham and cheese between. Press, cut, two layers.

hamburger.taste: One corner of the bun has gone soft with juice.
hamburger.hint: Press the patty flat; it sits better.
hamburger.name: Hamburger
hamburger.desc: Bun split, patty fried, a leaf of lettuce, then pressed down.

hash_brown.taste: A shell outside, soft strands in.
hash_brown.name: Hash Brown
hash_brown.desc: Grated potato, squeezed, pressed into a cake, browned on both sides.

hash_browns.taste: Pressed flat, browned on both sides.
hash_browns.hint: Squeeze the shreds dry or the cake falls apart.
hash_browns.name: Hash Browns
hash_browns.desc: Shred the potato, squeeze dry, press into cakes and fry both sides.

hot_cocoa.taste: A thin skin forms on top.
hot_cocoa.hint: Do not boil; pull it at the first bubbles.
hot_cocoa.name: Hot Cocoa
hot_cocoa.desc: Milk, cocoa and sugar over low heat, stirred until dark.

hot_dog.hint: Do not over-toast the bun; it scrapes.
hot_dog.name: Hot Dog
hot_dog.desc: Fry the sausage until the skin splits, tuck it in a roll, add tomato.

hummus.taste: Smooth, with a well pressed in the middle.
hummus.hint: Cook the beans until they crush at a touch.
hummus.name: Hummus
hummus.desc: Boil the beans soft, blend with spice, finish with oil.

iced_americano.taste: The ice has begun to melt; the taste thins.
iced_americano.hint: Cool the espresso before the ice or it clouds.
iced_americano.name: Iced Americano
iced_americano.desc: Espresso with cold water and a couple of cubes.

iced_latte.taste: Milk sinks then rises; two colours.
iced_latte.hint: Cold milk keeps the layers from collapsing.
iced_latte.name: Iced Latte
iced_latte.desc: Cold milk in the glass, espresso poured over slowly.

injera.hint: Let the batter ferment for the holes.
injera.name: Injera
injera.desc: Ferment the batter, spread thin, cook until it bubbles.

jam_toast.taste: Jam spread thick; the rim left bare.
jam_toast.hint: Spread while warm so it softens.
jam_toast.name: Jam Toast
jam_toast.desc: Toast the slice and spread jam while it is hot.

jollof.taste: Red rice, a crust at the pot bottom.
jollof.hint: Fry the tomato and spice until the oil runs.
jollof.name: Jollof Rice
jollof.desc: Fry tomato and spice, add rice and meat, steam.

juice.hint: Drink it fresh or it separates.
juice.name: Juice
juice.desc: Press the fruit, strain the coarse bits.

kebab.taste: The skewer still burns; the edges are charred.
kebab.hint: A night in the marinade keeps it tender.
kebab.name: Kebab
kebab.desc: Marinate cubed meat, skewer, grill until the edges catch.

kebab_wrap.taste: The meat is shaved off hot.
kebab_wrap.hint: Warm the flatbread or it cracks.
kebab_wrap.name: Kebab Wrap
kebab_wrap.desc: Lay out the bread, add meat and greens, sauce, roll tight.

khao_soi.taste: A nest of fried noodles on top, still crisp.
khao_soi.hint: The broth must be thick to cling.
khao_soi.name: Khao Soi
khao_soi.desc: Simmer coconut curry, add the clear noodle soup and meat, crown with crisp noodles.

kimchi_soup.hint: The longer it simmers, the deeper it gets.
kimchi_soup.name: Kimchi Soup
kimchi_soup.desc: Fry pickle and meat, add water, simmer till rich.

lasagna.taste: Layer on layer; it slumps when cut.
lasagna.hint: Sauce every layer or it bakes dry.
lasagna.name: Lasagna
lasagna.desc: Stack pasta, meat sauce and white sauce, bake until bubbling.

latte.taste: The milk arrives first; the bitterness catches up after.
latte.hint: Add a portion of milk to an americano.
latte.name: Latte
latte.desc: Milk pushes the bitterness back a little, and the whole cup goes soft.

lemonade.taste: Sour enough to wince, and you sip again.
lemonade.hint: Dissolve the sugar before the juice.
lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.desc: Squeeze the fruit, add sugar water, chill.

mac_cheese.taste: A browned crust, a pull underneath.
mac_cheese.hint: Cheese in two rounds deepens it.
mac_cheese.name: Mac and Cheese
mac_cheese.desc: Boil the pasta, fold with cheese and milk, bake until browned.

macaron.hint: Do not overmix or they flatten.
macaron.name: Macaron
macaron.desc: Ground nuts with sugar and egg white, piped small and baked, then filled.

macchiato.taste: A dab of milk on top, coffee underneath.
macchiato.hint: One spoon of milk; more makes it a latte.
macchiato.name: Macchiato
macchiato.desc: A small spoon of foam on the espresso, unstirred.

mango_lassi.taste: Thick enough to fight the straw.
mango_lassi.name: Mango Lassi
mango_lassi.desc: Blend fruit, yogurt and sugar smooth.

mango_sticky_rice.hint: Fold the coconut milk in hot so it drinks it.
mango_sticky_rice.name: Mango Sticky Rice
mango_sticky_rice.desc: Steam the rice, stir through coconut milk, serve with sliced fruit.

mapo_tofu.taste: Numbness first; the heat waits behind it.
mapo_tofu.hint: Slide the tofu in, never stir it.
mapo_tofu.name: Mapo Tofu
mapo_tofu.desc: Fry minced meat, add chili and soy sauce, slide in the bean curd.

mashed_potato.taste: Fine, with a few lumps left.
mashed_potato.hint: Mash while hot or it clumps.
mashed_potato.name: Mashed Potato
mashed_potato.desc: Boil and crush the potato, stir in milk and butter.

meat_sauce_rice.taste: The sauce sinks into the rice, saltier toward the bottom.
meat_sauce_rice.name: Rice with Meat Sauce
meat_sauce_rice.desc: Meat sauce reduced until thick, spooned over hot rice; the edges slump.

meat_soup.taste: Thick, with a sheen of fat on top.
meat_soup.name: Meat Soup
meat_soup.desc: Meat sliced thin, blanched in rolling broth until the color deepens.

milk_cereal.taste: Crisp at first, soft by the last spoon.
milk_cereal.name: Milk & Cereal
milk_cereal.desc: Cereal into a bowl, cold milk over it, left to soak.

milk_tea.hint: Let it sit off the heat a moment.
milk_tea.name: Milk Tea
milk_tea.desc: Boil milk, tea leaves and sugar, then take it off the heat and let it steep.

milkshake.taste: Too thick for the straw; use a spoon.
milkshake.hint: Chill the milk and cream first for thickness.
milkshake.name: Milkshake
milkshake.desc: Beat milk, cream and sugar until it coats the glass.

mint_tea.taste: Very sweet, and the mint comes out through your nose.
mint_tea.hint: Pour from a height for the foam.
mint_tea.name: Mint Tea
mint_tea.desc: Boil water with spice and sugar, pour high into the glass.

mocha.taste: Chocolate and coffee, neither clearly first.
mocha.hint: Melt the sugar first or it sinks.
mocha.name: Mocha
mocha.desc: Espresso with milk, dark chocolate and sugar, stirred until it darkens.

mooncake.taste: Cut it and it is dense, sweet without apology.
mooncake.hint: Press the mould hard or the pattern blurs.
mooncake.name: Mooncake
mooncake.desc: Press dough into a mould, brush egg, bake.

muffin.hint: Batter, sugar, butter -- fill a cup.
muffin.name: Muffin
muffin.desc: Batter into the cup, baked until it domes and cracks.

mushroom_risotto.taste: Creamy outside, a little bite at the core.
mushroom_risotto.hint: Keep stirring or it never thickens.
mushroom_risotto.name: Mushroom Risotto
mushroom_risotto.desc: Stir rice with mushroom and white sauce, finish with cheese.

mushroom_soup.hint: Add the white sauce slowly so it doesn't lump.
mushroom_soup.name: Mushroom Soup
mushroom_soup.desc: Browned mushrooms, white sauce and milk, cooked until it coats a spoon.

naan.hint: Slap it on a hot wall for the blisters.
naan.name: Naan
naan.desc: Roll the dough and bake hot until it spots.

nachos.taste: Cheese melts and pulls when you lift a chip.
nachos.hint: Pull it as the cheese just gives.
nachos.name: Nachos
nachos.desc: Spread chips with cheese and spice, bake until melted.

nasi_goreng.taste: Dry grains, plenty of wok smoke.
nasi_goreng.hint: Day-old rice, or it turns sticky.
nasi_goreng.name: Nasi Goreng
nasi_goreng.desc: Fry cold rice with meat and spice, top with a fried egg.

nasi_lemak.taste: Coconut in the rice, chilli at the rim.
nasi_lemak.hint: Soak the rice so it steams loose.
nasi_lemak.name: Nasi Lemak
nasi_lemak.desc: Soak the rice, steam it in coconut milk, serve with chilli.

noodle_soup.taste: The soup is hotter than the noodles; still warm at the last bite.
noodle_soup.name: Noodle Soup
noodle_soup.desc: Noodles boiled separately, broth on its own; combine at the end so nothing goes soft.

onigiri.hint: Rice around vegetable and meat, pressed tight.
onigiri.name: Onigiri
onigiri.desc: Wet your hands, shape the rice into a triangle, hide a little filling inside.

onion_rings.taste: Bite through and it is sweet inside.
onion_rings.hint: Cut the rings thick so the batter holds.
onion_rings.name: Onion Rings
onion_rings.desc: Slice onion into rings, coat in batter, fry until they float.

onion_soup.taste: Onions gone translucent, the broth pale brown.
onion_soup.hint: Soften them first or the soup bites.
onion_soup.name: Onion Soup
onion_soup.desc: Fry sliced onion soft, add stock, simmer till it darkens.

onion_tart.taste: Onions piled high, the rim charred.
onion_tart.hint: Cook the onions to sweetness first.
onion_tart.name: Onion Tart
onion_tart.desc: Press dough into a tin, top with soft onions and cheese, bake.

oyakodon.taste: Half-set egg slides over the rice.
oyakodon.hint: Two pours of egg, two textures.
oyakodon.name: Oyakodon
oyakodon.desc: Simmer meat and scallion, pour egg over, slide onto rice while loose.

pad_thai.taste: Sweet, sour and salt all at once.
pad_thai.hint: Hard heat, or the noodles clump.
pad_thai.name: Pad Thai
pad_thai.desc: Soak the noodles, then fry hard with prawns, egg and greens.

paella.taste: The crust at the bottom goes first.
paella.hint: Do not stir at the end; let it set.
paella.name: Paella
paella.desc: Spread rice and seafood in the pan, season, simmer until dry.

palak_paneer.hint: Add the cheese last or it crumbles.
palak_paneer.name: Palak Paneer
palak_paneer.desc: Boil and blend the greens, season, fold in cheese cubes.

pancake.taste: All little holes, drinking whatever you spread.
pancake.name: Pancake
pancake.desc: Ladle batter into a pan, turn it when bubbles pop, brown both sides.

pasta_tomato.taste: The strands wear red; the plate comes back clean.
pasta_tomato.hint: Straight from the pot into the sauce.
pasta_tomato.name: Tomato Pasta
pasta_tomato.desc: Boil the pasta, toss it through softened tomato.

persian_stew.hint: Spice late, or the perfume boils off.
persian_stew.name: Persian Stew
persian_stew.desc: Stew meat and beans, add greens and spice near the end.

peruvian_chicken.taste: Crisp skin, fruit acid in the meat.
peruvian_chicken.hint: Acid in the marinade keeps it tender.
peruvian_chicken.name: Peruvian Chicken
peruvian_chicken.desc: Marinate in spice and fruit juice, roast until the skin crisps.

pho.taste: Clear broth, a few slices floating.
pho.hint: Pour boiling, or the meat never turns.
pho.name: Pho
pho.desc: Boil the stock, pour over noodles, top with meat and greens.

pilaf.name: Pilaf
pilaf.desc: Soak the rice, fry with meat and spice, steam with water.

pita.hint: Hot and fast, or it never puffs.
pita.name: Pita
pita.desc: Roll the dough flat, bake hot until it balloons.

pbj_sandwich.taste: Sweet and salty, half and half.
pbj_sandwich.hint: Two slices, each with its own spread.
pbj_sandwich.name: Peanut Butter & Jam Sandwich
pbj_sandwich.desc: Peanut butter on one slice, jam on the other, pressed together.

pizza.taste: The rim puffs; the cheese still pulls.
pizza.hint: Rest the dough or it will not stretch.
pizza.name: Pizza
pizza.desc: Stretch the dough, spread tomato, scatter cheese, bake till the rim blisters.

poached_egg.taste: A thin veil of white around liquid gold.
poached_egg.hint: A splash of vinegar keeps it together.
poached_egg.name: Poached Egg
poached_egg.desc: Slide the egg in just as the water shivers. Lift it gently.

popcorn.taste: A few never popped and bite hard.
popcorn.hint: Leave a gap for the steam.
popcorn.name: Popcorn
popcorn.desc: Corn into a hot pot, lid on, until the popping thins.

potato_salad.taste: Mealy, cold, better after a rest.
potato_salad.hint: Boil until a chopstick goes through.
potato_salad.name: Potato Salad
potato_salad.desc: Potato and egg crushed into dressing. Eat it cold.

pour_over.taste: The cup that slowed down; the sourness walks in front.
pour_over.hint: An extraction without the equipment — you wait a little longer.
pour_over.name: Pour-over
pour_over.desc: Water circles the grounds and you have to let it fall through on its own.

poutine.taste: The gravy is thick; the fries below have given up.
poutine.hint: Double-fry so they hold the sauce.
poutine.name: Poutine
poutine.desc: Fry the potatoes crisp, pour gravy and white sauce, add meat.

pudding.name: Pudding
pudding.desc: Egg and milk together, baked in a water bath — that is why it trembles.

raita.taste: Cold, and it puts the fire out.
raita.name: Raita
raita.desc: Fold chopped vegetables into yogurt, dust with spice.

ramen.hint: Reheat just before serving; it softens fast.
ramen.name: Ramen
ramen.desc: Bring the clear noodle soup to a boil, top with pork and egg, finish with scallion.

ravioli.taste: Edges pressed tight, the filling bulging.
ravioli.hint: Wet the rim or they open in the pot.
ravioli.name: Ravioli
ravioli.desc: Roll the dough thin, add filling, fold and seal, then boil.

red_curry.taste: Red oil on top, thick below.
red_curry.hint: A pinch of sugar rounds the heat.
red_curry.name: Red Curry
red_curry.desc: Simmer coconut milk and spice, add meat, cook until the oil splits.

ribs.taste: A glossy crust; the bone slides out.
ribs.hint: Low and slow, glaze at the end.
ribs.name: Ribs
ribs.desc: Rub with spice, bake low, glaze with sugar at the finish.

rice_cake.hint: Rice ground to a slurry, steamed with sugar.
rice_cake.name: Rice Cake
rice_cake.desc: Rice slurry into a mold, steamed until a chopstick lifts it whole.

roast_chicken.taste: Crisp skin, juices left in the pan.
roast_chicken.hint: Dry the skin before it goes in.
roast_chicken.name: Roast Chicken
roast_chicken.desc: Rub the meat with spice and butter, roast till the skin is gold and juices run clear.

roasted_corn.taste: Charred spots, and sweet at the bite.
roasted_corn.hint: Roast until the kernels swell, then butter.
roasted_corn.name: Roasted Corn
roasted_corn.desc: Grill the corn until it spots, brush with butter and spice.

roasted_vegetables.hint: Cut them the same size so they cook evenly.
roasted_vegetables.name: Roasted Vegetables
roasted_vegetables.desc: Toss cut vegetables with oil and spice, roast until the edges catch.

rose_dessert.taste: Cloying, and you keep going back.
rose_dessert.hint: Do not over-reduce or it sets hard.
rose_dessert.name: Rose Dessert
rose_dessert.desc: Thicken milk and sugar, pour into moulds, scatter nuts.

samosa.taste: Triangular; the potato burns your tongue.
samosa.hint: Seal the edges or the oil gets in.
samosa.name: Samosa
samosa.desc: Wrap potato filling in pastry, crimp into triangles, fry.

sandwich.taste: Soft toast, crisp edge of the fried egg.
sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.desc: Two slices, egg and greens between, pressed and cut.

satay.taste: Thick sauce, oil still dripping from the skewer.
satay.hint: Add the nut paste last or it turns bitter.
satay.name: Satay
satay.desc: Marinate and skewer the meat, grill, serve with nut sauce.

sausage_sauerkraut.hint: Rub the cabbage with salt until it softens and sours.
sausage_sauerkraut.name: Sausage & Sauerkraut
sausage_sauerkraut.desc: Shred the cabbage, rub it with salt and spice, then simmer with sausage until sour and savoury.

scallion_noodle.taste: Scallions fried dark, the oil carries it.
scallion_noodle.hint: Low and slow, don't burn them.
scallion_noodle.name: Scallion Noodles
scallion_noodle.desc: Scallions in oil until fragrant, fished out, the oil tossed through noodles.

scone.taste: Dry outside, still a little damp inside.
scone.hint: Butter rubbed into the dough, baked until it cracks.
scone.name: Scone
scone.desc: Baked until it splits along the seam.

scrambled_egg.hint: Small pan, low heat, keep the spatula moving.
scrambled_egg.name: Scrambled Eggs
scrambled_egg.desc: Eggs beaten into melted butter, pushed slowly into a pile.

seafood_pancake.hint: A thin batter cooks the seafood through.
seafood_pancake.name: Seafood Pancake
seafood_pancake.desc: Fold seafood into batter, fry flat until both sides catch.

sesame_bun.hint: Griddle first, then bake, for the crust.
sesame_bun.name: Sesame Bun
sesame_bun.desc: Roll dough with oil, flatten, top with sesame, bake.

shawarma.taste: Shaved thin; sauce runs into your palm.
shawarma.hint: Warm the bread so it folds.
shawarma.name: Shawarma
shawarma.desc: Warm the bread, layer meat and greens, sauce, roll tight.

shepherd_pie.hint: Keep the mash dry or it sinks.
shepherd_pie.name: Shepherd's Pie
shepherd_pie.desc: Fry meat and vegetables into a filling, top with mash, bake till golden.

shumai.hint: Dough, meat, vegetable -- a little bag left open.
shumai.name: Shumai
shumai.desc: No rising; the wrapper is rolled thin, pleated, the filling showing at the top.

soda.taste: Plenty of fizz; a sip makes you burp.
soda.hint: Chill before opening; the gas stays longer.
soda.name: Soda
soda.desc: Squeeze the fruit, add sugar water, chill until it fizzes.

souffle.taste: It falls as it leaves the oven; eat fast.
souffle.hint: Beat the whites to peaks and fold gently.
souffle.name: Soufflé
souffle.desc: Fold yolk custard into whipped whites, bake in a ramekin until it rises.

soy_rice.taste: Soy sauce coats each grain; the bean comes through.
soy_rice.hint: Hot rice, or the smell never comes.
soy_rice.name: Soy Sauce Rice
soy_rice.desc: Soy sauce around the rim of hot rice, then stir.

sparkling_water.taste: Bubbles rise and the throat prickles.
sparkling_water.name: Sparkling Water
sparkling_water.desc: Chill the water, add a squeeze of fruit.

spring_roll.taste: Crisp, and steam rushes out at the bite.
spring_roll.hint: Squeeze the filling dry or they burst.
spring_roll.name: Spring Roll
spring_roll.desc: Wrap the filling tight, fry golden.

steak.taste: Pink inside, charred at the edge.
steak.hint: Bring it to room temperature first.
steak.name: Steak
steak.desc: Sear both sides, add butter and spice, rest before slicing.

steamed_egg.hint: Egg and water, steamed; keep the heat low.
steamed_egg.name: Steamed Egg
steamed_egg.desc: Water and egg whisked, steamed just until set -- no honeycomb on the surface.

stew.hint: Broth, vegetable, meat -- low and slow.
stew.name: Stew
stew.desc: Simmered low; the liquid reduces and the flavor thickens.

sushi.hint: Wet your hands or the rice sticks.
sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.desc: Shape warm rice, drape fish over it, add a sliver of greens.

taco.hint: Warm the tortilla or it cracks.
taco.name: Taco
taco.desc: Warm the tortilla, fill with meat, greens and spice.

tagine.taste: Lift the lid and sweet meets savoury.
tagine.hint: Low and slow, until the meat let go.
tagine.name: Tagine
tagine.desc: Slow-cook meat and vegetables with spice, scatter nuts at the end.

tamale.taste: Unwrap the leaf and it is soft.
tamale.hint: Beat the masa until it holds.
tamale.name: Tamale
tamale.desc: Wrap meat in corn dough and leaves, then steam through.

tamarind_sauce.taste: Sharply sour; a little goes far.
tamarind_sauce.hint: Add sugar by the spoon and taste.
tamarind_sauce.name: Tamarind Sauce
tamarind_sauce.desc: Simmer fruit in water, strain, reduce with sugar.

tandoori_chicken.hint: The longer it sits, the deeper the colour.
tandoori_chicken.name: Tandoori Chicken
tandoori_chicken.desc: Marinate meat in spice and milk, bake until the surface reddens.

tangyuan.hint: They are done when they float.
tangyuan.name: Tangyuan
tangyuan.desc: Roll dough into balls, boil until they rise.

tea_egg.taste: Cracks carry the colour inward, fading as they go.
tea_egg.hint: Crack the shell and soak overnight.
tea_egg.name: Tea Egg
tea_egg.desc: Boil, crack, then simmer low in spiced water. No rushing.

tea_rice.taste: The tea is clear, the rice still stands.
tea_rice.hint: Do not let the tea get too hot or the rice will fall apart.
tea_rice.name: Tea Rice
tea_rice.desc: Rice in a bowl, hot tea poured over, a little greens.

tempura.taste: The batter is thin enough to see through.
tempura.name: Tempura
tempura.desc: Dip seafood in loose batter, fry pale gold.

thali.hint: Make a little of each so the tray looks full.
thali.name: Thali
thali.desc: Rice in the middle; beans, greens and sauce in bowls around it.

tiramisu.taste: Dusted on top, soft beneath the spoon.
tiramisu.hint: A night in the cold marries the flavours.
tiramisu.name: Tiramisu
tiramisu.desc: Dip cake in coffee, layer with cream, dust with grounds, chill.

toast.taste: Cut thick, a dark ring at the edge.
toast.name: Toast
toast.desc: A loaf into a stack. Good plain, better with anything.

toast_slice.taste: Dry, crisp, a ring of colour.
toast_slice.hint: A thin scrape of butter is enough.
toast_slice.name: Toast Slices
toast_slice.desc: Sliced bread, buttered, baked crisp. Best beside soup.

tom_yum.taste: Sour and hot at once: a wince, then another spoon.
tom_yum.hint: Aromatics last, or the perfume leaves.
tom_yum.name: Tom Yum
tom_yum.desc: Simmer seafood and mushroom with spice and coconut milk.

tomato_soup.taste: Sour, warm, the stomach relaxes first.
tomato_soup.hint: Cook the tomatoes down before adding stock.
tomato_soup.name: Tomato Soup
tomato_soup.desc: Tomatoes softened in the pan, stock poured in. Deeper colour, sweeter soup.

tostada.hint: Fry it through or it goes soft.
tostada.name: Tostada
tostada.desc: Fry the corn cake crisp, top with meat and cheese.

tres_leches.taste: Milk seeps out when you cut it.
tres_leches.name: Tres Leches
tres_leches.desc: Bake the cake, soak with milk and cream, chill.

tuna_sandwich.hint: Taste the mix before it goes in.
tuna_sandwich.name: Tuna Sandwich
tuna_sandwich.desc: Seafood and dressing between toast. A leaf of lettuce helps.

turkish_coffee.taste: A layer of grounds at the bottom; stop short of it.
turkish_coffee.hint: Pull it at the foam, never boil.
turkish_coffee.name: Turkish Coffee
turkish_coffee.desc: Heat grounds, water and sugar; pour at the first foam.

turmeric_rice.hint: Bloom the spice in oil first.
turmeric_rice.name: Turmeric Rice
turmeric_rice.desc: Bloom the spice in oil, fold through the rice.

twice_cooked_pork.hint: Boil before slicing or it shreds.
twice_cooked_pork.name: Twice-cooked Pork
twice_cooked_pork.desc: Boil and slice the pork, then fry again with greens and chili.

vegetable_salad.name: Garden Salad
vegetable_salad.desc: Leaves torn, a little oil, a toss. Nothing else to say.

vegetable_soup.taste: Clear; warm all the way down.
vegetable_soup.name: Vegetable Soup
vegetable_soup.desc: Broth first, vegetables last, pulled off the heat the moment they soften.

vienna_coffee.taste: Cream floats on top: sweet first, bitter after.
vienna_coffee.hint: Whip the cream to stand; do not stir it in.
vienna_coffee.name: Vienna Coffee
vienna_coffee.desc: Sweeten the espresso and crown it with whipped cream.

waffle.taste: Sugar in the grid has turned to crust.
waffle.hint: A softer dough presses in evenly.
waffle.name: Waffle
waffle.desc: Press the dough into the iron and bake until the edges crisp.

cocoa_shake.taste: Cold enough to sting your teeth; the cocoa comes through.
cocoa_shake.hint: Crush the ice first for a smoother shake.
cocoa_shake.name: Cocoa Shake
cocoa_shake.desc: Cocoa, milk, ice and sugar, blended thick.

white_rice.taste: Nothing added, just the rice's own sweetness.
white_rice.hint: A splash too much is porridge; too little, grit.
white_rice.name: White Rice
white_rice.desc: A bowl of plain rice. Looks empty; everything else stands on it.

wonton.taste: Skin thin enough to see light, oil on the broth.
wonton.hint: Cook them at once or they stick.
wonton.name: Wonton
wonton.desc: Roll thin wrappers, fold in meat, poach in stock.

yogurt_soup.hint: Keep it low or the yogurt splits.
yogurt_soup.name: Yogurt Soup
yogurt_soup.desc: Stir yogurt, flour and spice over low heat until thick.

yorkshire_pudding.taste: Hollow in the middle, crisp at the rim.
yorkshire_pudding.hint: The fat must be hot before the batter.
yorkshire_pudding.name: Yorkshire Pudding
yorkshire_pudding.desc: Pour batter into hot fat and bake until it rises.

zongzi.taste: The rice has taken the colour by the time it opens.
zongzi.hint: Soak the rice or it never steams through.
zongzi.name: Zongzi
zongzi.desc: Wrap rice and meat in leaves, tie tight, steam through.

yogurt.name: Yogurt
yogurt.desc: Milk and sugar, left warm until it sets.

bean.name: Mixed Beans
bean.desc: Dry, hard, a whole sack. Everything but soy.

bread.name: Bread
bread.desc: Lighter than dough; tap it and it sounds hollow.

broth.name: Broth
broth.desc: Skim the foam and what's left is pale.

butter.name: Butter
butter.desc: Out of the cold, it first breaks into a thin sweat.

cheese.name: Cheese
cheese.desc: Tiny holes in the cut face.

coconut_milk.name: Coconut Milk
coconut_milk.desc: Thick as it pours, faintly sweet.

coffee_bean.name: Green Coffee Beans
coffee_bean.desc: Pale green beans; they smell like a morning that hasn't woken yet.

coffee_ground.name: Ground Coffee
coffee_ground.desc: Ground, the aroma scatters faster — and is easier to remember.

corn.name: Corn
corn.desc: Silk still clinging to the cob.

cream.name: Cream
cream.desc: Skimmed off the milk, thick enough to cling to a spoon.

cream_cheese.name: Cream Cheese
cream_cheese.desc: Rich with milk, softening on warm bread.

dough.name: Dough
dough.desc: Knead until it stops sticking; it will still rise slowly.

egg.name: Eggs
egg.desc: In a little basket by the stove; there are always a few each day.

flour.name: Flour
flour.desc: Lift it and it slips through your fingers; very light.

jam.name: Jam
jam.desc: Fruit and sugar, simmered until it coats a spoon.

meat_sauce.name: Meat Sauce
meat_sauce.desc: Reduced over a low flame, thicker the longer it goes.

dark_chocolate.taste: Bitter and blunt, the snapped edge still glossy.
dark_chocolate.hint: More cocoa, less sugar; keep the heat low.
dark_chocolate.name: Dark Chocolate
dark_chocolate.desc: Cocoa stirred into melted butter and sugar, pressed into a mould to set.

milk_chocolate.taste: Milk first, bitterness catching up behind.
milk_chocolate.hint: Don't let the milk boil — pull it as soon as the edge bubbles.
milk_chocolate.name: Milk Chocolate
milk_chocolate.desc: Cocoa with fresh milk, butter and sugar, stirred smooth and poured to set.

lava_cake.taste: The middle runs when you cut it; the rim stays soft.
lava_cake.hint: Pull it early or the centre sets.
lava_cake.name: Molten Chocolate Cake
lava_cake.desc: Dark chocolate, butter, egg and sugar, baked until the middle still runs.

milk.name: Milk
milk.desc: White, quiet, like a sentence left unfinished.

noodle.name: Noodles
noodle.desc: Cut a little uneven; shake them loose before they go in.

nuts.name: Nuts
nuts.desc: A handful, shell and oil on your fingers.

oil.name: Vegetable Oil
oil.desc: The old bottle by the stove; it pours out clear and yellow.

peanut_butter.name: Peanut Butter
peanut_butter.desc: Ground peanuts, oil rising on its own.

rice.name: Rice
rice.desc: Husked grain; it rustles faintly in the hand.

roasted_bean.name: Roasted Coffee Beans
roasted_bean.desc: Darker now, and the aroma pushes harder than the green beans did.

sausage.name: Sausage
sausage.desc: Meat in casing, fried until the skin splits.

sugar.name: Sugar
sugar.desc: Fine grains; on your fingertips they're slightly sticky.

syrup.name: Syrup
syrup.desc: Sugar melted into water, thicker once cool.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.desc: Glossy red, heavy in the hand.

water.name: Water
water.desc: The thing you can always take from a recipe. The catalog doesn't record it.

pork.name: Pork
pork.desc: Wrapped in paper, fat and lean in stripes; cold to the touch.

beef.name: Beef
beef.desc: Dark and coarse-grained; the knife has to be patient.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.desc: Pale and mild, willing to become something else.

shrimp.name: Shrimp
shrimp.desc: Still moving, shells a translucent green.

leafy.name: Leafy Greens
leafy.desc: Tied in a bunch, water still beading on the leaves.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.desc: The outer leaf wilts; inside it is still crisp.

root.name: Root Vegetables
root.desc: Muddy and heavy, a pale bruise where it snapped.

scallion.name: Scallion
scallion.desc: White root, green leaf, sharp and sweet at once.

apple.name: Apple
apple.desc: A faint bloom on the skin; it cracks when you bite.

banana.name: Banana
banana.desc: A hand of them, just spotting black.

tropical.name: Tropical Fruit
tropical.desc: Mango, pineapple, coconut — they smell of sun.

lemon.name: Lemon
lemon.desc: Pocked skin; squeeze it and your whole hand smells of it.

salt.name: Salt
salt.desc: A small bag, the least of the lot, and every pot wants a pinch.

ice.name: Ice
ice.desc: Little blocks knocked out of the freezer, hard enough to clink.

vanilla.name: Vanilla
vanilla.desc: A short dark pod; the sweetness takes its time coming out.

cocoa.name: Cocoa
cocoa.desc: Bitter powder ground fine; it turns to a brown haze the moment it meets heat.

olive_oil.name: Olive Oil
olive_oil.desc: Pressed out green, with a faint catch at the back of the throat.

tea_leaf.name: Tea Leaves
tea_leaf.desc: Dry leaves still curled shut, awake the second hot water hits them.

ice_cream_scoop.name: A Scoop of Ice Cream
ice_cream_scoop.desc: Rounded off neat; a spoon stuck in it will stand there a moment.
ice_cream_scoop.taste: Cold and clean; the sweetness takes its time.
ice_cream_scoop.hint: Scoop one out of the tub.

shaved_ice.name: Shaved Ice
shaved_ice.desc: A big bowl of snow that slumps by half once the syrup lands.
shaved_ice.taste: Syrup seeps down through the cracks; the sweet is bright.
shaved_ice.hint: Shave the ice fine and pour syrup over.

popsicle.name: Popsicle
popsicle.desc: Frozen in a mould; the stick pulls out clean.
popsicle.taste: Cold first, then the fruit creeps in.
popsicle.hint: Freeze ice and fruit together in a mould.

smoothie.name: Smoothie
smoothie.desc: Cold wraps the pulp; a film of mist stays on the glass.
smoothie.taste: Thick enough to hold the straw, pulp still grainy.

ice_bar.name: Ice Bar
ice_bar.desc: Firm enough to leave a row of teeth marks.
ice_bar.taste: Milk rides on top; the ice melts slowly behind it.
ice_bar.hint: Freeze ice and milk hard, then cut.

milk_pudding.name: Milk Pudding
milk_pudding.desc: It wobbles when the spoon lifts — and still holds.
milk_pudding.taste: Goes down without a sound; milk stays at the back of the tongue.
milk_pudding.hint: Milk and sugar, frozen just short of hard.

vanilla_ice_cream.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
vanilla_ice_cream.desc: A whole tub, surface smoothed flat, the spoon's path still showing.
vanilla_ice_cream.taste: Vanilla sweetens first; the cold catches up after.
vanilla_ice_cream.hint: Ice, milk, sugar and a pod of vanilla.

chocolate_ice_cream.name: Chocolate Ice Cream
chocolate_ice_cream.desc: So dark in the tub it looks like mud, and digs out heavy.
chocolate_ice_cream.taste: Bitter and sweet hold each other off; neither wins.
chocolate_ice_cream.hint: Freeze cocoa and milk together; it goes dark.

fruit_ice_cream.name: Fruit Ice Cream
fruit_ice_cream.desc: All one colour, and you can still taste the shapes.
fruit_ice_cream.taste: The fruit froze hard; the sweet carries a little sour.
fruit_ice_cream.hint: Use whatever fruit is at hand.

sundae.name: Sundae
sundae.desc: Jam over the ball, then a cap of cream.
sundae.taste: Cream melts first, jam sweetens after, ice last.
sundae.hint: One scoop, with jam and cream piled on.

black_tea.name: Black Tea
black_tea.desc: The colour sinks to the bottom; a ring stays on the cup.
black_tea.taste: Tannin clean; the sweetness comes back slowly.
black_tea.hint: Just let hot water open the leaves.

green_tea.name: Green Tea
green_tea.desc: The leaves never fully open; the liquor stays pale.
green_tea.taste: Green bitterness first, then the cool of leaves.
green_tea.hint: Steep it shorter than black tea.

lemon_tea.name: Lemon Tea
lemon_tea.desc: The slices float up and the tea goes pale.
lemon_tea.taste: Sour hits first; the tea catches it from behind.
lemon_tea.hint: Two slices of lemon in the tea.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Grind it, and you've got the start of flour.

whole_wheat_flour.name: Whole Wheat Flour
whole_wheat_flour.desc: The bran stays in, so the color runs deep.

cocoa_powder.name: Cocoa Powder
cocoa_powder.desc: Ground cocoa: a clean, bitter edge.

marshmallow.name: Marshmallow
marshmallow.desc: Press it and it slowly springs back.

whole_wheat_bread.taste: A hard crust over soft crumb.
whole_wheat_bread.hint: The color of whole wheat runs deep.
whole_wheat_bread.name: European Bun
whole_wheat_bread.desc: Baked until the crust knocks hollow.

whole_wheat_cracker.taste: The more you chew, the sweeter it gets.
whole_wheat_cracker.hint: Roll it thin for a cleaner snap.
whole_wheat_cracker.name: Whole Wheat Cracker
whole_wheat_cracker.desc: Rolled thin and baked to a pale brown rim.

chocolate_chip_cookie.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
chocolate_chip_cookie.desc: Baked to brown edges, still soft in the middle.

chocolate_cookie.name: Chocolate Cookie
chocolate_cookie.desc: Dough and cocoa baked until the top cracks.

oreo.taste: Two dark cookies around one sweet layer.
oreo.name: Oreo
oreo.desc: Two chocolate cookies pressed around cream.

roasted_marshmallow.hint: One turn over the fire is enough.
roasted_marshmallow.name: Toasted Marshmallow
roasted_marshmallow.desc: Toasted until the surface blisters; eat it hot.

smore.taste: Toast, chocolate and whole wheat together.
smore.name: S'more
smore.desc: A whole wheat cracker around toasted marshmallow and dark chocolate.

chili.name: Chili Pepper
chili.desc: Unapologetically red; cut one and your hands smell of it.

soy.name: Soybeans
soy.desc: A handful of pale rounds; soak overnight and they grind.

tofu.name: Tofu
tofu.desc: Soy milk curdled and pressed into a block, light as nothing.

kimchi.name: Kimchi
kimchi.desc: Cabbage rubbed with chili and salt; a few days and it sours just right.

tomato_egg_stirfry.taste: The tomato gives its juice first; the egg stays soft.
tomato_egg_stirfry.hint: Take the egg out half-cooked and slide it back at the end.
tomato_egg_stirfry.name: Tomato and Egg Stir-fry
tomato_egg_stirfry.desc: Tomato fried down to juice, egg slid in, red and yellow in one pan.

stir_fried_greens.taste: Crisp, with a breath of the wok.
stir_fried_greens.hint: High heat, quick toss, no lid.
stir_fried_greens.name: Stir-fried Greens
stir_fried_greens.desc: Whatever greens are at hand, a pinch of salt, straight out of the pan.

vinegar_potato_shreds.taste: Clean sourness, the potato still crisp.
vinegar_potato_shreds.hint: Soak the shreds first or they glue together.
vinegar_potato_shreds.name: Vinegar Potato Shreds
vinegar_potato_shreds.desc: Potatoes cut to threads, soaked, sourness added just before the pan leaves the fire.

braised_tofu.hint: Sear one side of the tofu, then pour the soy over.
braised_tofu.name: Braised Tofu
braised_tofu.desc: Tofu seared to a thin shell; chili and sugar reduce to a glossy sauce.

kung_pao_chicken.taste: Peanuts first; the heat catches up after.
kung_pao_chicken.hint: Peanuts go in last or they lose their crunch.
kung_pao_chicken.name: Kung Pao Chicken
kung_pao_chicken.desc: Chicken cubes passed through oil, dried chili and peanuts tossed in, out of the pan fast.

yu_xiang_pork.taste: Sour, sweet, hot — all three in one bite.
yu_xiang_pork.hint: Mix the sugar and soy beforehand; there is no time once the pan is hot.
yu_xiang_pork.name: Yuxiang Shredded Pork
yu_xiang_pork.desc: Pork shreds velveted; pickled chili meets sweet vinegar in the pan.

spicy_chicken.taste: Hunting the chicken in the chili pile is half the pleasure.
spicy_chicken.hint: Fry the chicken twice; perfume the chili, then return the chicken.
spicy_chicken.name: Chongqing Spicy Chicken
spicy_chicken.desc: Chicken fried hard and buried in a fistful of chili, tossed through.

xiao_chao_rou.taste: The chili steals the show from the pork.
xiao_chao_rou.hint: Render the pork first; the chili goes in after.
xiao_chao_rou.name: Stir-fried Pork
xiao_chao_rou.desc: Pork rendered, chili tossed in, soy poured down the side of the wok.

shui_zhu_rou_pian.taste: A red layer on the soup, tender pork underneath.
shui_zhu_rou_pian.hint: Slide the pork in last and do not stir.
shui_zhu_rou_pian.name: Boiled Pork Slices
shui_zhu_rou_pian.desc: Stock at a rolling boil, pork slid in, chili on top, hot oil poured over.

dan_dan_noodles.taste: Once you toss it, everything good is at the bottom.
dan_dan_noodles.hint: Noodles and topping stay apart until you eat.
dan_dan_noodles.name: Dan Dan Noodles
dan_dan_noodles.desc: Noodles bowled; minced pork, chili and peanuts piled on top.

dry_pot_cabbage.taste: The charred edges are the point.
dry_pot_cabbage.hint: Tear the cabbage, do not cut it.
dry_pot_cabbage.name: Dry Pot Cabbage
dry_pot_cabbage.desc: Cabbage torn by hand, bacon and chili rendering fat, all tossed together.

steamed_chili_fish.taste: The heat steams in; it is not poured on.
steamed_chili_fish.hint: High heat, and do not steam it a minute longer.
steamed_chili_fish.name: Steamed Fish Head with Chili
steamed_chili_fish.desc: Fish head covered in chopped chili, steamed, soy drizzled on at the end.

budae_jjigae.taste: Everything is in it, and it all works.
budae_jjigae.hint: Fry the kimchi first or the soup stays flat.
budae_jjigae.name: Budae Jjigae
budae_jjigae.desc: Kimchi, sausage and noodles in one pot, chili in the broth, boil until it rolls.

kimchi_fried_rice.hint: Day-old rice; fresh rice goes gluey.
kimchi_fried_rice.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
kimchi_fried_rice.desc: Chopped kimchi first, rice and egg after, chili to finish.

dak_galbi.taste: Sweet heat glazed on the skin.
dak_galbi.hint: Chili and rice go in together for the crust.
dak_galbi.name: Spicy Stir-fried Chicken
dak_galbi.desc: Chicken seared at the edges, chili and rice in, tossed until a crust forms.

pad_kra_pow.hint: Fry the egg crisp at the edge, soft in the middle.
pad_kra_pow.name: Pad Kra Pao
pad_kra_pow.desc: Beef and chili over hard heat, over rice, with a fried egg on top.

laksa.taste: Coconut wraps the heat; the finish lasts longer.
laksa.hint: Coconut milk last or it splits.
laksa.name: Laksa
laksa.desc: Fry chili to red oil; coconut milk and rice noodles go in, shrimp last.

sambal_shrimp.taste: The shrimp is sweet; the sambal is not polite.
sambal_shrimp.hint: Shrimp last; out of the pan the moment they turn red.
sambal_shrimp.name: Sambal Shrimp
sambal_shrimp.desc: Chili and onion pounded into paste, fried, shrimp tossed through twice.

mirchi_salan.taste: Whole chilies stewed soft, the heat in the sauce.
mirchi_salan.hint: Slit the chilies first or nothing gets in.
mirchi_salan.name: Mirchi Salan
mirchi_salan.desc: Chilies stewed with nuts and spice, cream stirred in at the end.

chilli_chicken.hint: Dust the chicken in flour first or the sauce slides off.
chilli_chicken.name: Chilli Chicken
chilli_chicken.desc: Floured chicken fried crisp, chili and soy reduced to a glaze.

vindaloo.taste: Sour first, then heat, then another spoon.
vindaloo.hint: Fry spice and chili until the oil turns red.
vindaloo.name: Vindaloo
vindaloo.desc: Pork braised with chili and spice, sourness braised into the meat.

shakshuka.taste: The yolk runs; use the bread.
shakshuka.hint: Crack the eggs and leave them; lid on, low heat.
shakshuka.name: Shakshuka
shakshuka.desc: Tomato and chili cooked to sauce, eggs cracked in, lid on until set.

lemon_chili_chicken.taste: A rub of lemon peel and the heat brightens.
lemon_chili_chicken.hint: Squeeze the lemon at the end; baked peel turns bitter.
lemon_chili_chicken.name: Lemon Chili Roast Chicken
lemon_chili_chicken.desc: Chicken skin rubbed with chili and oil, roasted crisp, half a lemon squeezed over.

paprikash.hint: Cream off the heat; never let it boil.
paprikash.name: Paprikash
paprikash.desc: Chicken and onion stewed soft, chili in, cream turning it pink.

nashville_hot_chicken.taste: One bite and your lips go numb first.
nashville_hot_chicken.hint: Stir the chili into hot frying oil and pour it over.
nashville_hot_chicken.name: Nashville Hot Chicken
nashville_hot_chicken.desc: Chicken fried dark, chili and butter burned to red oil, poured over.

chili_con_carne.taste: The longer it stews, the deeper the heat.
chili_con_carne.hint: Brown the beef first, then add liquid.
chili_con_carne.name: Chili con Carne
chili_con_carne.desc: Beef browned, tomato and beans in, chili stewed down thick.

jerk_chicken.taste: Smoke arrives first, then the heat.
jerk_chicken.hint: Marinate overnight; char the skin without burning it.
jerk_chicken.name: Jerk Chicken
jerk_chicken.desc: Chicken rubbed with chili and spice, roasted charred, still tender inside.

elote.taste: Sweet, salty, hot, all smeared on the corn.
elote.hint: Char the corn before you smear it.
elote.name: Elote
elote.desc: Corn charred, cream and cheese smeared on, a layer of chili on top.

doro_wat.taste: A heavy heat; you need bread with it.
doro_wat.hint: Cook the onions dark; do not rush it.
doro_wat.name: Doro Wat
doro_wat.desc: Onions cooked dark, chili and chicken in, eggs buried in at the end.

peri_peri_chicken.taste: Crisp skin, the heat hanging on it.
peri_peri_chicken.hint: Brush the chili oil twice, the last time at the very end.
peri_peri_chicken.name: Peri-Peri Chicken
peri_peri_chicken.desc: Chicken turned in chili oil, grilled until the skin curls.

suya.taste: Spice and chili on the meat; the more you chew, the drier and better.
suya.hint: Slice the meat thin; spice goes on last.
suya.name: Suya
suya.desc: Beef sliced thin, rubbed with chili and groundnut spice, grilled to dry edges.

chili_dog.taste: The bread soaks the chili oil and beats the sausage.
chili_dog.hint: Warm the chili first; toast the bread last.
chili_dog.name: Chili Dog
chili_dog.desc: Sausage fried in its fat, bread around it, chili and cheese over the top.

miso.name: Miso
miso.desc: Soybeans fermented into a brown paste; one spoonful is enough savor.

rice_noodle.name: Rice Noodles
rice_noodle.desc: Rice soaked, ground, pressed into thin strands and dried.

nian_gao.name: Rice Cakes
nian_gao.desc: Pounded out of cooked rice; slice it and it still pulls a little.

miso_soup.taste: Salty with a sweet finish; the tofu falls apart at a touch.
miso_soup.hint: Stir the miso in at the end and never let it boil.
miso_soup.name: Miso Soup
miso_soup.desc: Miso dissolved into the broth, tofu at the bottom, scallion floating.

tofu_dengaku.taste: Char first, then the sweet-salty glaze.
tofu_dengaku.hint: Dry the tofu surface first or the glaze slides off.
tofu_dengaku.name: Tofu Dengaku
tofu_dengaku.desc: Tofu grilled until the edges brown, brushed with miso and sugar, then back under the heat.

miso_ramen.taste: The broth is thick and the noodles still firm — just right.
miso_ramen.hint: Do not boil the miso; thin it in just before serving.
miso_ramen.name: Miso Ramen
miso_ramen.desc: Clear noodle soup turned miso-dark, egg and scallion floating on top.

fried_rice_noodle.taste: Dry and savory, every strand its own.
fried_rice_noodle.hint: Soak the noodles soft first, then only a few tosses in the pan.
fried_rice_noodle.name: Stir-fried Rice Noodles
fried_rice_noodle.desc: Rice noodles tossed with egg, greens and soy until the pan smells dry and toasted.

tteokbokki.taste: Sweet inside the heat; the more you chew, the stickier.
tteokbokki.hint: Soak the rice cakes first or they glue to the pan.
tteokbokki.name: Tteokbokki
tteokbokki.desc: Rice cakes rolling in a glossy red sauce, chili and sugar clinging to each piece.

di_san_xian.name: Three Treasures of the Earth
di_san_xian.desc: Potato and eggplant, plus whatever vegetable is in season, pan-fried until the edges soften.
di_san_xian.taste: Potato soft, eggplant softer, the third one still has a little bite.
di_san_xian.hint: Potato and eggplant first, then any vegetable.

scallion_pancake.name: Scallion Pancake
scallion_pancake.desc: Roll out the dough, brush with oil and scatter scallions, roll it up, flatten again, and pan-fry until both sides brown.
scallion_pancake.taste: Crisp outside; layer after layer of scallion oil inside.
scallion_pancake.hint: Oil and scallions on the dough, roll, flatten, fry.

liangpi.name: Liangpi
liangpi.desc: Steam a thin sheet of batter, cut it into strips, and dress with chili oil.
liangpi.taste: Cool, slippery, chili oil clinging to the edges.
liangpi.hint: Steam the batter thin, cut into strips, toss with chili oil.

window.title: By the Window
window.body:
I don't know whether this letter will be read.
There's no road outside the window, only light. But every morning the light falls in exactly the same place.
If you live here too, you must have seen it.
— the one who writes
window.name: By the Window
window.desc: A letter left on the windowsill, its edges bleached by light.

task_window_1.title: The First Cup
task_window_1.body:
The cup is on the shelf. So is the kettle.
Boil the water once, let the dry beans go wet, and the smell comes out.
Leave it on the windowsill when it's done — I want to see it steam.
— the one who writes
task_window_1.name: The First Cup
task_window_1.desc: The words are written on the back of a card, pressed hard.
task_window_1.task_title: Put the kettle on and pour
task_window_1.task_body:
Grind and pour a dripper.
Hand it over from the third mailbox tab when ready.

coffee_machine.title: The Crate at the Door
coffee_machine.body:
A crate was left at the door, a little taller than me.
Inside is a coffee machine. Brass. Wipe it and you can see yourself.
Beside it: a bottle of milk and a bag of beans.
It was mine once. It's yours now. Don't let it sit idle.
— the one who writes
coffee_machine.name: The Crate at the Door
coffee_machine.desc: A delivery note is tucked into the envelope, its corners curled.

milk_merchant.title: The Grocer
milk_merchant.body:
The cart passes at this hour every day.
The milk is in a box in the back of the cart, under a damp cloth. Keep it out of the sun, he says; once it warms, it won't keep.
The cart carries more than milk — rice, flour, oil, salt, jars and tins.
In all my years here I bought from him many times and never said much.
— if it's any use to you, remember it.
milk_merchant.name: The Grocer
milk_merchant.desc: There are dried milk stains along the edge of the envelope.
milk_merchant.task_body:
He said some shops make it this way: espresso under hot milk, a thin layer of foam on top.
"There's a research desk on this cart," he said, tapping the edge of the table. "Put two things in and wait — see what comes out."
Make an espresso first, then put it on the desk together with milk and try.

teach_market.title: The Cart and the Hill
teach_market.body:
You can get things from two places now. Don't walk only one.
The cart comes once a day, and when it sells out you wait — buy early if you want it.
The slope behind the house grows things too. Lean out the window and reach; no one to ask.
Use both, or the counter runs empty.
Even when you eat alone, wait for the water to boil.
teach_market.name: The Cart and the Hill
teach_market.desc: On the back is a crooked little drawing of a cart.

sugar_jar.title: The Sugar Jar
sugar_jar.body:
The jar was left by someone else; a layer of undissolved sugar sits at the bottom.
I put it where you can reach it.
If you're already making that milky thing, put in a spoonful.
— no need to return it.
sugar_jar.name: The Sugar Jar
sugar_jar.desc: There's a ring of sugar around the rim, hard enough to scrape with a nail.

flour_sack.title: The Flour Sack
flour_sack.body:
The letters on the sack were soaked by water; only half remain.
I guess you still remember that dough has to be kneaded —
there's a white mark on the edge of the table, left by whoever was here before.
Have you started making things yet?
flour_sack.name: The Flour Sack
flour_sack.desc: A kraft-paper sack with flour leaking out at one corner.

teach_upgrade.title: The Loose Screw
teach_upgrade.body:
The things on the counter start to creak after a while.
Don't put up with it. Open them up, tighten what's loose, and they go faster.
And that board beside the stove — set two things on it and it shows you a third.
