Try it once and you'll see.
teach_upgrade.name: The Loose Screw
teach_upgrade.desc: A short brass screw falls out of the envelope.

butter_warmth.title: The Warmth of Butter
butter_warmth.body:
Butter has to come out of the cold and sit until it softens on its own.
Heat it and it splits; leave it alone and it softens just right.
It took me a few tries to remember that.
butter_warmth.name: The Warmth of Butter
butter_warmth.desc: The paper has faint grease spots; up close it smells of milk.

grinder_owner.title: The Grinder's Old Owner
grinder_owner.body:
That machine belonged to someone who ground beans once a day.
By the few-hundredth grind the person had gone, and the machine stayed.
It wobbles because something in there came loose.
No need to fix it.
grinder_owner.name: The Grinder's Old Owner
grinder_owner.desc: There's a crooked gear drawn in the corner.

oven_heat.title: The Heat of the Oven
oven_heat.body:
The glass in the door is always fogged; you can't see inside.
It has baked a great many things, most of all other people's breakfasts.
When you pull it open, the heat hits your face first —
that's the moment in this room that feels most like someone lives here.
Bake a small tray of cookies first. Butter and sugar, until the edges go just brown.
oven_heat.name: The Heat of the Oven
oven_heat.desc: The paper's edges are slightly yellowed, as if baked.
oven_heat.task_body:
Six cookies.
Bake them, then hand them over from the third mailbox tab.

task_oven_heat_1.title: The Second Batch
task_oven_heat_1.body:
The cookies came out well.
Bake one more batch of croissants — slower this time, let them rise on their own.
I left flour in the sack. Enough for three tries.
task_oven_heat_1.name: The Second Batch
task_oven_heat_1.desc: A small dried smear of butter is on the paper.
task_oven_heat_1.task_body:
One croissant.
Hand it over from the third mailbox tab when ready.

fridge_hum.title: The Humming Box
fridge_hum.body:
Woke this morning and there was a steel box inside the back door, humming.
A note on top: 'Colder inside than out. Put water in; in a while it is ice. Don't mind the noise — it never stops.'
I set a bowl of water inside and stood listening for a long while. It showed no sign of stopping.
By evening the ice had taken shape — thick at the edges, thin in the middle, splitting at a knock.
fridge_hum.name: The Humming Box
fridge_hum.desc: A humming steel box turned up inside the back door.

before_leaving.title: Time to Start
before_leaving.body:
The truck had been stopped for a long time.
Long enough that I began to think this was how it was always meant to be — stopped, then slowly becoming a room.
This morning the light came in from the other side. I pushed the door open and stood at the threshold as usual.
Something tapped softly at the rear.
I hesitated, then left the door for the first time, crossed the ground to the back, and turned around.
Only then did I see the whole of it: an old food truck, most of its paint gone, wheels sunk in the dirt.
So the room I'd been living in all along was this truck.
It had run to a great many places, and then stood still so long it forgot itself.
I went back to the door and wiped a small patch of dust from the inside.
Underneath, a line of painted letters showed —
'OFF THE EATEN PATH'.
I wiped the keys clean and sat back down in the driver's seat.
Time to start.
before_leaving.name: Time to Start
before_leaving.desc: The paper has crease lines, as if it was opened and folded again and again.

east_asia_arrive.title: First Stop
east_asia_arrive.body:
The truck stopped.
I don't know whether it decided to, or whether the road just needed to catch its breath.
Outside the window: a row of low eaves, and things hung under them knocking against each other in the wind. Someone walked past the truck without looking up.
I opened the window a crack. Warm air came in with a very clean smell — rice, and a little char.
The bowls here are small and the chopsticks are light. Nobody talks while they eat.
east_asia_arrive.name: First Stop
east_asia_arrive.desc: Thin paper, corners curled, as if it sat on a windowsill a long time.

task_east_asia_arrive_1.title: Two Pairs of Chopsticks
task_east_asia_arrive_1.body:
Someone is sitting on the doorstep at the corner, eating noodles.
He doesn't look up. He only says: make two dishes from here, let me smell whether they're right.
Just two. More than that and he can't finish.
task_east_asia_arrive_1.name: Two Pairs of Chopsticks
task_east_asia_arrive_1.desc: A chopstick-crease runs across the paper.
task_east_asia_arrive_1.task_body:
Two is enough. No need to pick the hardest.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

east_asia_note.title: The Paper on the Step
east_asia_note.body:
In the morning I opened the door and found a piece of paper on the step. Torn from an exercise book, edges uneven.
Three lines, in a crooked hand:
"One hot bowl. It has to have soup."
"The rolled-up kind. Like last time."
"Something sweet. Not too sweet."
No name. No time to come and collect it.
I put the paper on the windowsill. On windy days it moves a little.
east_asia_note.name: The Paper on the Step
east_asia_note.desc: A page torn from an exercise book, edges uneven.

task_east_asia_note_1.title: Three Lines on the Step
task_east_asia_note_1.body:
That paper has one more line:
"Two different soups. That will do."
I folded it and left it by the windowsill.
task_east_asia_note_1.name: Three Lines on the Step
task_east_asia_note_1.desc: A shoe print sits on one corner.
task_east_asia_note_1.task_body:
Something warm. Two different soups will do.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

east_asia_leave.title: Leaving
east_asia_leave.body:
On the third morning the truck moved on its own.
When I woke, the eaves had already shrunk to a line far behind.
The paper was still on the windowsill. I put it in the notebook, next to the page that has writing on it.
Some places you only stop at for three days, and remember for a long time.
Where the next stop is, I don't know. The truck does.
east_asia_leave.name: Leaving
east_asia_leave.desc: A sheet folded and unfolded many times, kept inside.

middle_page.title: The Middle Page of the Catalog
middle_page.body:
Turn to the middle page and you'll find that someone noted something down before you.
Different handwriting, drawn a different way.
What he recorded was the same cup — only that day he added one thing less than I did.
Record-keeping is like that — everyone writes their own.
The notebook grows thicker. Sometimes, turning to the back, I forget which page I started from.
middle_page.name: The Middle Page of the Catalog
middle_page.desc: Two different inks on the paper.

beyond_paper.title: Beyond the White Paper
beyond_paper.body:
There's color at the edge of the paper.
Just not anywhere you can see it yet.
Finish writing this page and we'll talk about the rest.
— still the one who writes
beyond_paper.name: Beyond the White Paper
beyond_paper.desc: There's a faint wash of color on the back of the sheet, invisible from the front.
beyond_paper.task_body:
Work out one new dish at the research table.
Unlocked is done.

southeast_asia_arrive.title: Damp
southeast_asia_arrive.body:
This stop is loud.
Before the truck even settled, sound closed in from every side: motorbikes, shouting, water falling from somewhere high.
The air is wet. It sits on the skin like cloth that never dried.
Outside the window the green is so dense you can't see what's behind it.
Someone knocked twice on the side of the truck. I rolled the window down. He handed me a bundle of leaves and left without a word.
The leaves were still wet.
southeast_asia_arrive.name: Damp

task_southeast_asia_arrive_1.title: Fire Under the Awning
task_southeast_asia_arrive_1.body:
A small fire is burning under the rain awning.
The one tending it says the taste here needs heat, needs sour, and needs someone to watch the fire.
Make two and show me.
task_southeast_asia_arrive_1.name: Fire Under the Awning
task_southeast_asia_arrive_1.desc: The paper is a little damp.
task_southeast_asia_arrive_1.task_body:
Two. Hot or sour, either is fine.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

southeast_asia_note.title: Back of a Cigarette Packet
southeast_asia_note.body:
No paper at the door today. This one came through the window gap.
The back of a cigarette packet, in pencil:
"Sour, hot, the one with coconut."
"That soup from last time. I thought about it for a long while."
There is another line below, rubbed out and written over. I can't read it.
I stood it up by the window.
southeast_asia_note.name: Back of a Cigarette Packet
southeast_asia_note.desc: The back of a cigarette packet, the pencil rubbed out once.

task_southeast_asia_note_1.title: Writing on a Wet Cloth
task_southeast_asia_note_1.body:
A wet cloth lies on the windowsill, a sheet of paper laid over it.
The damp has softened the paper and the ink has run. All I can read is “two”.
Take two orders and deliver them.
task_southeast_asia_note_1.name: Writing on a Wet Cloth
task_southeast_asia_note_1.desc: The cloth is half dry; the words remain.
task_southeast_asia_note_1.task_body: Don't keep anyone waiting too long.

southeast_asia_leave.title: Rain
southeast_asia_leave.body:
It was raining when the truck left.
The rain hit the roof in a dense patter, like someone jogging across it.
I left a bowl on the windowsill to cool.
When I came back for it, the bowl was empty and there was a leaf underneath.
The truck drove a long way, and the leaf was still dripping.
southeast_asia_leave.name: Rain
southeast_asia_leave.desc: One corner of the envelope is soft, as if rain got to it.

vegetable_patch.title: The Vegetable Patch
vegetable_patch.body:
There's a small plot of turned earth in the corner outside the window.
The soil is loose; a stick with a faded red string is stuck in it.
I don't know who planted it, but it's growing better than anything indoors.
If you're short on vegetables, reach out from the window — don't pull the whole plant.
vegetable_patch.name: The Vegetable Patch
vegetable_patch.desc: A stick with a faded red string tied to it.
vegetable_patch.task_body:
Three bunches of leafy greens.
Gather them, then hand them over from the third mailbox tab.

rice_sack.title: The Rice Sack
rice_sack.body:
The sack is printed with characters I can't read; the only one I recognize is "rice".
The rest of the story is missing.
Scoop out a handful. The grains slip through my fingers with a dry rustle.
Whoever lived here before probably wasn't from around here either.
rice_sack.name: The Rice Sack
rice_sack.desc: The sack is tied shut with hemp cord, twice.
rice_sack.task_body:
Five measures of rice.
Gather them, then hand them over from the third mailbox tab.

south_asia_arrive.title: Color
south_asia_arrive.body:
The colors here are heavy.
A layer of fine dust settles on the window. I wipe it with my sleeve and make a bright streak; slowly it fogs over again.
Someone has set up a pot outside. The flame licks the bottom. The wind carries the smell in — too many kinds to name, but every one of them is loud.
south_asia_arrive.name: Color
south_asia_arrive.desc: Fine dust on the paper; it smudges when you touch it.

task_south_asia_arrive_1.title: The Color on Their Hands
task_south_asia_arrive_1.body:
People here eat with their fingers.
Turmeric and chili stain them. It doesn't wash off, so they let it stay.
Make three. The color has to be right.
task_south_asia_arrive_1.name: The Color on Their Hands
task_south_asia_arrive_1.desc: A small yellow stain is on the corner of the envelope.
task_south_asia_arrive_1.task_body:
Three. Check the color and the spice.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

south_asia_note.title: Back of a Bill
south_asia_note.body:
The back of a bill, in round, hard-pressed letters:
"The yellow one. The one with beans in it."
"Flatbread. Two."
"Not too much heat."
At the bottom, a crooked drawing of a bowl.
I made it. While I cooked, the same song played outside the whole time.
south_asia_note.name: Back of a Bill
south_asia_note.desc: The back of an old bill; there is more writing on the back than the front.

task_south_asia_note_1.title: A Note on the Spice Sack
task_south_asia_note_1.body:
A string is tied around the spice sack, with a slip of paper threaded on it.
The slip says: three meatless dishes.
Nothing else.
task_south_asia_note_1.name: A Note on the Spice Sack
task_south_asia_note_1.task_body:
Three meatless ones, but do not skimp on the spice.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

south_asia_leave.title: The Pot
south_asia_leave.body:
The pot was still there when the truck pulled away.
The fire hadn't gone out. The smoke climbed slowly.
I closed the window. The smell stayed in the truck anyway.
I wrote this page three times before I got the word right.
I didn't cross out the wrong ones.
south_asia_leave.name: The Pot
south_asia_leave.desc: A small hole in the paper where the pen pressed through.

butcher_street.title: The Street with the Butcher
butcher_street.body:
Out the window to the left, third crossing: a butcher's shop.
The owner doesn't ask what you're making, only how much.
Today someone left a parcel of meat on the windowsill, wrapped in oil paper, the knot tied the old way.
I haven't seen him in a long time. I wonder if he still remembers me.
butcher_street.name: The Street with the Butcher
butcher_street.desc: There's a grease stain on the letter.

middle_east_arrive.title: Under the Wall
middle_east_arrive.body:
The truck stopped below a wall. Earth-yellow, bleached pale by the sun.
At noon the whole street was empty. Every sound had gone into hiding, leaving only heat.
In the evening people came out all at once.
Someone spread a cloth beside the truck, set down a copper pot and a few small cups. He poured one and pushed it onto my windowsill.
Very sweet. Sweet enough to taste bitter.
middle_east_arrive.name: Under the Wall
middle_east_arrive.desc: The paper has gone brittle from the sun.

task_middle_east_arrive_1.title: The Oven at the Wall
task_middle_east_arrive_1.body:
An oven is buried at the foot of the wall. Its fire has never gone out.
Press dough against it and it puffs up in a moment.
Make three. Let's see whether you can press them on steady.
task_middle_east_arrive_1.name: The Oven at the Wall
task_middle_east_arrive_1.desc: The edges of the paper are singed crisp.
task_middle_east_arrive_1.task_body:
Three. Do not let the fire run hot.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

middle_east_note.title: No Signature
middle_east_note.body:
A sheet of paper, crumpled and smoothed out again. Large letters:
"The sesame one."
"Grilled. I want it dark at the edges."
"Tea. Sweet."
There is a small grease mark in one corner, like a thumbprint.
I turned the paper over. On the back, a few faint lines:
"Once this slope was grassland, with a pair of flowers, bright red. She pointed them out and said they were anemones."
"She said the anemone's flower language is wind."
"When she rode, the grass bent away on both sides, as if the wind were passing through. I liked watching her ride. I thought that one day I might ride beside her."
"Now there is only sand on the slope."
middle_east_note.name: No Signature
middle_east_note.desc: A small grease mark on the paper; up close it smells of sesame.

task_middle_east_note_1.title: The Shepherd’s Slip
task_middle_east_note_1.body:
A shepherd passed by the truck and left a slip of paper under the wall. His flock waited outside the wall, and he kept one hand on the rope.
I guessed that when he eats, he has only one hand free.
It says: Out with the sheep, the wind comes down the slope. I want to eat something like the wind.
Below that, one more line: Rolled up. Meat, vegetables, easy to carry.
I pulled the slip out. Rolled up, one hand free — that sounds like shawarma.
task_middle_east_note_1.name: The Shepherd’s Slip
task_middle_east_note_1.desc: Sand has frayed the edge of the slip.
task_middle_east_note_1.task_body: Make one shawarma. Hand it over from the third mailbox tab when it is ready.

middle_east_leave.title: Sweet
middle_east_leave.body:
We left at dawn, the wall's shadow long across the road.
The copper pot was still there. The cups had been collected.
I poured out yesterday's half-finished tea, washed the cup, and set it on the windowsill.
A long way out, the wall in the mirror was still yellow.
From this stop, what I remember is sweet.
middle_east_leave.name: Sweet
middle_east_leave.desc: A little sugar stuck to the flap, hard now.

stove_fire.title: Keep the Fire Low
stove_fire.body:
What's in that pot burns if the flame gets too high.
I tried many times. In the end I found that if I turned it down, the soup would reduce on its own.
A clearer broth holds its flavor better.
stove_fire.name: Keep the Fire Low
stove_fire.desc: One corner of the letter is singed brown.
stove_fire.task_body:
One vegetable soup.
Hand it over from the third mailbox tab when ready.

mediterranean_arrive.title: Salt
mediterranean_arrive.body:
The wind here is salty.
The truck stopped on a slope. Down below, water — so bright it makes your eyes ache if you look too long.
Someone down the slope was hauling in a net. When it came up, something silver flashed and went out.
At noon they ate by the roadside. Bread torn open, oil poured on, salt scattered.
Too simple to call a meal, and yet it took a long time.
mediterranean_arrive.name: Salt
mediterranean_arrive.desc: A few grains of salt on the paper, white where they dried.

task_mediterranean_arrive_1.title: Oil Drying in the Sun
task_mediterranean_arrive_1.body:
A row of bottles is drying on the roof; the oil inside is green.
Things here are simple: oil, salt, fire, and time.
Make three. Don't use too much.
task_mediterranean_arrive_1.name: Oil Drying in the Sun
task_mediterranean_arrive_1.desc: An oil ring marks the envelope.
task_mediterranean_arrive_1.task_body:
Three. Easy on the oil.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

mediterranean_note.title: The Napkin
mediterranean_note.body:
A paper napkin, pencil, very light:
"Tomato and that white cheese."
"Pasta. Not too soft."
"If there's lemon, a squeeze."
The wind pushed it into the door gap. By the time I picked it up the edges had curled.
I made it once, the way the napkin says. Salt and oil both light. Halfway through, it tasted like somewhere I had eaten before — I could not remember where.
Eat alone long enough and you start to forget what home tasted like.
mediterranean_note.name: The Napkin
mediterranean_note.desc: A paper napkin, soft even when flattened.

task_mediterranean_note_1.title: The Note by the Oil Bottle
task_mediterranean_note_1.body:
A note stands beside the oil bottle.
It says: three meatless dishes, while they are hot.
I put the note back.
task_mediterranean_note_1.name: The Note by the Oil Bottle
task_mediterranean_note_1.desc: An oily fingerprint is on the note.
task_mediterranean_note_1.task_body:
Three fresh ones. Do not hold back on the olive oil.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

mediterranean_leave.title: Use Less
mediterranean_leave.body:
It rained a little the day we left, then stopped.
The water below turned grey, and stayed bright.
I tore up yesterday's bread and left it on the outer windowsill.
A long way out, my mouth still tasted of salt.
From this stop, I learned to put in less.
mediterranean_leave.name: Use Less
mediterranean_leave.desc: A little oil in the corner, as if the paper was held.

steamer_lid.title: Water on the Steamer Lid
steamer_lid.body:
Be careful when you lift the lid — water runs down the edge.
The water is hot, and it hurts when it lands on your hand.
I was scalded a lot as a child. Later I learned to lift it just a crack and let the steam out first.
Be patient. The food is cooking inside.
steamer_lid.name: Water on the Steamer Lid
steamer_lid.desc: A ring of condensation on the lid.
steamer_lid.task_body:
One portion of dumplings.
Hand them over from the third mailbox tab when ready.

western_arrive.title: Fog
western_arrive.body:
The truck stopped farther out than usual. The land here is flat — flat enough that you can see fog starting a long way off.
Condensation formed on the window. I drew a line through it, then wiped it away.
Someone had left a small basket at the door, covered with cloth. Underneath: bread, still warm.
The crust was hard and shed crumbs when broken. The inside was soft.
The butter here is yellow, not white.
western_arrive.name: Fog
western_arrive.desc: The paper is thick, like kitchen paper.

task_western_arrive_1.title: Half a Menu
task_western_arrive_1.body:
Only half the menu is left on the wall.
The half that remains says: serve hot.
Make three. They have to be hot when they reach the table.
task_western_arrive_1.name: Half a Menu
task_western_arrive_1.desc: The paper is stiff, like it was torn off a menu.
task_western_arrive_1.task_body:
Three. They should still be hot at the table.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

western_note.title: A Small Basket of Bread
western_note.body:
A note on good paper, in small writing:
"Soup. Thick."
"Bread. The kind you can dip."
"The pot kind. With beef."
Under the note was a small piece of butter wrapped in wax paper.
I held the butter close and smelled it. It smells familiar, but I cannot remember where I've smelled it before.
western_note.name: A Small Basket of Bread
western_note.desc: There used to be butter under this note; the paper kept the mark.

task_western_note_1.title: The Official’s Menu Board
task_western_note_1.body:
A menu board turned up on the counter, not one of ours.
On the back, pressed hard: A pack of barbarians from out of town tore down the lighthouse. Nobody did a thing.
The writing stops there. The pen has gouged the board.
A gap follows, then: One Middle Eastern grill. Char it a bit. Let it be them.
An official seal is stamped at the bottom, the ink smeared.
He means to take it out on that meat — burn it, get it out of his system, and then find the heart to clean up the mess.
task_western_note_1.name: The Official’s Menu Board
task_western_note_1.desc: An old word is still there, impossible to wipe off, with deep gouges beside it.
task_western_note_1.task_body: Make one kebab, char it a bit, and hand it over from the third mailbox tab when it is ready.

western_leave.title: Warmth
western_leave.body:
The fog hadn't lifted when we left.
The truck went slowly, as if it didn't want to either.
I ate the last of the bread. Crumbs fell on my lap.
A little butter got on this page. It went through, and there's a mark on the back too.
From this stop, what I remember is warmth.
western_leave.name: Warmth
western_leave.desc: Butter has soaked through the paper.

americas_arrive.title: The Straight Road
americas_arrive.body:
The road here is straight — so straight you can't see a bend.
After the truck stopped, nobody came for a long time. Far off there were tin roofs that rattled in the wind.
Toward evening a car pulled up beside me and the driver rolled his window down, asking if I wanted to try what he had.
I shook my head. He smiled, set a paper bag on my windowsill, and drove off.
The bag was hot. The grease had gone through the paper.
americas_arrive.name: The Straight Road
americas_arrive.desc: A grease mark soaked through the envelope.

task_americas_arrive_1.title: The Car on the Straight Road
task_americas_arrive_1.body:
A road runs straight through, without a bend in sight.
A radio is playing in a car. Nobody turns it off.
Make three. Bigger portions.
task_americas_arrive_1.name: The Car on the Straight Road
task_americas_arrive_1.desc: A tire track of grey dust crosses the envelope.
task_americas_arrive_1.task_body:
Three. Give a little more.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

americas_note.title: The Receipt
americas_note.body:
The back of a receipt, ballpoint:
"Meat. The kind between bread."
"Potatoes. Cut into strips."
"Something sweet, cold, with bubbles."
The letters are huge, filling almost the whole paper.
Ordering two portions for one person is a habit the road teaches.
americas_note.name: The Receipt
americas_note.desc: The back of a receipt; the prices are still on the front.

task_americas_note_1.title: A Hand in the Car Window
task_americas_note_1.body:
The car is parked at the roadside, its window rolled halfway down.
A hand comes out and holds up two fingers.
I'm guessing that means two orders.
task_americas_note_1.name: A Hand in the Car Window
task_americas_note_1.desc: An ink fingerprint marks the envelope.

americas_leave.title: Never Saw the Face
americas_leave.body:
We left at first light. The road was still straight.
I folded the paper bag and put it in the notebook.
The grease mark was still there a day later.
The truck had gone a long way before I realized I never saw that man's face clearly.
From this stop, I remember the hand.
Two fingers, a small gesture, enough.
The world kept moving outside the window; I sat and watched. I never went down most of those roads, and a lot of sentences never got finished.
americas_leave.name: Never Saw the Face
americas_leave.desc: A paper bag folded into four; the grease mark is still there.

africa_arrive.title: The Sun Sets Slowly
africa_arrive.body:
The sun sets slowly here.
The truck stopped under a tree. The shade covered only half of it. The other half was too hot to touch.
Toward evening someone built a fire nearby. A small fire, a large pot.
Someone brought over a bowl. Thick, dark.
I took a mouthful. Very hot. Strong with peanuts.
africa_arrive.name: The Sun Sets Slowly
africa_arrive.desc: The paper is darker than the others.
africa_arrive.task_body:
Any one dish from Africa.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

task_africa_arrive_1.title: The Sun Sets Slowly
task_africa_arrive_1.body:
The sun goes down slowly here.
Slow enough for a pot to finish stewing, slow enough for people to sit and wait.
Make two. No rush.
task_africa_arrive_1.name: The Sun Sets Slowly
task_africa_arrive_1.desc: The paper has yellowed in the sun.
task_africa_arrive_1.task_body:
Two. Slow is fine.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

africa_note.title: A Burnt Corner
africa_note.body:
A piece of paper with a burnt edge:
"Stew. Cook it until it falls apart."
"The yellow root. Mash it."
"Flatbread. To dip."
The letters are stroke by stroke, like someone who doesn't write often.
africa_note.name: A Burnt Corner
africa_note.desc: One corner of the paper was licked by fire; the edge is charred.

task_africa_note_1.title: The Clock That Slowed
task_africa_note_1.body:
The clock on the wall stopped once; someone set it to three and it started again.
It runs slow — so slow that an afternoon barely moves the hands.
Someone wants three street snacks, and says there is no hurry.
task_africa_note_1.name: The Clock That Slowed
task_africa_note_1.desc: The envelope is light; only one sheet inside.
task_africa_note_1.task_body:
Three you can eat on the move. Spice is welcome.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

africa_leave.title: Slow
africa_leave.body:
The fire was still burning when we left.
There was a small stool under the tree that hadn't been there before.
I washed the bowl and set it on the outer windowsill.
A long way out, the fire in the mirror was only a dot.
From this stop, I learned to slow down.
africa_leave.name: Slow
africa_leave.desc: A little ash on the envelope, as if it came from beside a fire.

fast_food_arrive.title: The Last Stop
fast_food_arrive.body:
The last stop is busier than I expected.
Neon burns from dusk until late, turning the window into blocks of color.
People here walk fast and eat fast. Someone stood by the truck, finished a meal, crumpled the paper, threw it in a bin, and left.
I watched for a long time.
I think this is the first time I've seen someone treat a meal as something to get through.
fast_food_arrive.name: The Last Stop
fast_food_arrive.desc: Very white paper, as if pulled from a printer tray.
fast_food_arrive.task_body:
Any one fast-food dish.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

task_fast_food_arrive_1.title: The Last Shop
task_fast_food_arrive_1.body:
This street ends here.
The last shop still has its light on. There's no one behind the counter.
Make two, while the light is still on.
task_fast_food_arrive_1.name: The Last Shop
task_fast_food_arrive_1.desc: A faded logo is printed on the envelope.
task_fast_food_arrive_1.task_body:
Two. Quick.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

fast_food_note.title: The Receipt Slip
fast_food_note.body:
A small printed receipt, the letters tiny:
"One. All of it."
"Drink. With ice."
"Quickly."
Below the last line, someone has added two words in pen:
"Thank you."
fast_food_note.name: The Receipt Slip
fast_food_note.desc: A receipt; someone wrote two words on the back in pen.

task_fast_food_note_1.title: Three Before Closing
task_fast_food_note_1.body:
The light is about to go off.
Finally someone speaks from behind the counter: three more, the last three.
Cook these three, and that's today done.
task_fast_food_note_1.name: Three Before Closing
task_fast_food_note_1.desc: An oil spot is on the envelope.
task_fast_food_note_1.task_body:
Three more, then we close up.
Confirm from the third mailbox tab when done.

fast_food_leave.title: All Put Away
fast_food_leave.body:
I didn't leave right away.
The truck stayed where it was while the lights went out one by one.
I spread out every piece of paper from this road and put them in order.
Torn exercise-book edges, cigarette-packet backs, napkins, a burnt corner, a printed receipt.
The handwriting is all different. Some I recognize. Some I don't.
Some of these I keep not for the words but because the handwriting looks like it belongs to someone I know.
I put them away again, into the notebook.
Then the truck moved.
fast_food_leave.name: All Put Away
fast_food_leave.desc: A thick envelope with several folded sheets inside.

on_the_road.title: Still on the Road
on_the_road.body:
The truck didn't stop.
Before dawn I put the table away and opened the notebook by the window.
Outside are the places I passed through: the morning market's lamps coming on one by one, steam in the alley mouth, charcoal still glowing out in the desert.
They line up and fade far behind.
I don't look back again. The truck keeps going.
on_the_road.name: Still on the Road
on_the_road.desc: A very light envelope with a single page inside.

east_asia_noodle_stand.title: The Noodle Stand in the Back Alley
east_asia_noodle_stand.body:
The innkeeper sent word: those three lines came from the noodle stand in the back alley south of town.
The next day the noodle man pushed his stand up beside the truck. Two low tables, and a pot that never came off the boil.
He didn't look up. He only said: 'My girl wrote that. She's picky.'
He dropped noodles into the pot and added a ladle of broth.
'Your broth is decent. Want to learn?'
Two pans hang by the stove — one for stir-frying, one for boiling.
east_asia_noodle_stand.name: The Noodle Stand in the Back Alley
east_asia_noodle_stand.desc: A note in pencil, flour still on the back.

task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.title: The Stand's Errand
task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.body:
The noodle man sent word: have two bowls of clear noodle soup ready tomorrow.
He says he wants to see whether my broth holds up.
'Noodles are noodles. Broth is broth. Don't muddle them.'
I counted my flour and eggs. Enough. Two bowls.
task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.name: The Stand's Errand
task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.desc: A slip with a time and a place, neater than the last one.
task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.task_title: Bring two bowls of clear noodle soup
task_east_asia_noodle_stand_1.task_body:
Two bowls of clear noodle soup.
Hand them over from the third mailbox tab when ready.

boiled_egg.desc: Eggs in cold water, timing from the boil.

cake.name: Bake a Cake

candied_fruit.name: Candied Fruit
candied_fruit.desc: Skewer the fruit, dip in hot sugar, let it set.

cappuccino.hint: Its name wears a little hat; drinking it is like a sweet cloud.

cappuccino.desc: Foam: espresso first, two parts milk steamed thick, foam floating on top.

caprese.name: Caprese
caprese.desc: Slice tomato and cheese, overlap them, add spice.

caramel_macchiato.desc: Syrup in the glass, milk and espresso over it, a caramel streak on top.

carrot_cake.name: Carrot Cake
carrot_cake.desc: Fold grated carrot into the batter, bake until a skewer comes clean.

ceviche.name: Ceviche
ceviche.desc: Cure fish slices in fruit juice until opaque, season.

chai.name: Chai
chai.desc: Two parts milk with tea leaves, spice and sugar, simmered dark.

cheese_stick.name: Cheese Sticks
cheese_stick.desc: Cheese in batter, into the oil.

cheese_toast.name: Cheese Toast
cheese_toast.desc: Toast under cheese until it melts.

cheeseburger.name: Cheeseburger
cheeseburger.desc: Lay a slice of cheese on the near-done patty and cover it to melt.

cheesecake.name: Cheesecake
cheesecake.desc: Fold cream cheese and sugar through the batter, pour into a tin, bake until the edge sets.

chicken_curry.name: Chicken Curry
chicken_curry.desc: Stew: spice toasted, chicken in, milk simmered down thick.

chicken_wrap.name: Chicken Wrap
chicken_wrap.desc: Fry and slice the meat, roll it with greens in a flatbread.

cinnamon_roll.name: Cinnamon Roll
cinnamon_roll.desc: Roll the dough, spread butter, sugar and cinnamon, slice and bake.

clear_noodle_soup.name: Clear Noodle Soup
clear_noodle_soup.desc: Noodles bowled, clear stock poured over.

club_sandwich.name: Club Sandwich
club_sandwich.desc: Toast the bread, stack meat, egg and greens, cut into triangles.

coconut_dessert.name: Coconut Dessert
coconut_dessert.desc: Reduce coconut milk with sugar, add fruit, chill.

cold_brew.name: Cold Brew
cold_brew.desc: Coffee grounds steep in cold water in the fridge all afternoon before the flavor comes out.
cold_brew.hint: Cold water, coffee grounds, and the fridge; leave it alone.

con_panna.name: Con Panna
con_panna.desc: A small shot under a cloud of cream, a blanket for something bitter.

cookie.name: Bake Cookies
cookie.desc: Spread into thin rounds: the edges brown before the middle has time.

corn_soup.name: Corn Chowder
corn_soup.desc: Corn and milk blended, then boiled.

corn_tortilla.desc: Toast: corn and flour into a dough, rolled thin, toasted until it blisters.
corn_tortilla.hint: Thin as paper, and it can wrap almost anything.

couscous.name: Couscous
couscous.desc: Rub flour into grains, steam, toss with vegetables and spice.

cream_cheese.name: Cream Cheese
cream_cheese.desc: Whip: milk and butter whipped thick enough to spread.

cream_puff.name: Cream Puff
cream_puff.desc: The shell puffs up; once cool, cream goes in from the bottom.

creamed_spinach.name: Creamed Spinach
creamed_spinach.desc: Blanch and squeeze the spinach, chop, fold into white sauce and butter.

creamy_mushroom_chicken.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
creamy_mushroom_chicken.desc: Brown the chicken, fry the mushrooms, add white sauce and reduce.

creme_brulee.name: Creme Brulee
creme_brulee.desc: Baked until set, dusted with sugar, torched into a thin shell.
creme_brulee.hint: Egg and cream first; sugar goes on top at the very end.

croissant.name: Bake a Croissant
croissant.desc: Dough folded over butter a few times, and the layers come out of the oven.

curry_puff.name: Curry Puff
curry_puff.desc: Wrap curry filling in pastry, bake until flaky.

curry_rice.name: Curry Rice
curry_rice.desc: Fry meat and vegetables, add spice and water, thicken, pour over rice.

dal.name: Dal
dal.desc: Boil the beans until they break down, then season.

dumpling.name: Dumplings
dumpling.desc: Steam: dough rolled, filled with pork, a pinch of scallion, steamed.

egg_drop_soup.name: Egg Drop Soup
egg_drop_soup.desc: A thin stream of egg into boiling stock.

egg_pancake.name: Egg Pancake
egg_pancake.desc: Whisk egg and flour, pour thin into a pan, fry both sides.

egg_roll.name: Egg Roll
egg_roll.desc: Spread thin, rolled layer by layer.

egg_salad_sandwich.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
egg_salad_sandwich.desc: Crushed egg and dressing, into toast.

egg_tart.name: Egg Tart
egg_tart.desc: Bake: dough pressed into cups, custard poured in, baked to a skin.

egg_toast.name: Egg Toast
egg_toast.desc: Buttered toast, fried egg on top.

espresso.desc: Pull: hot water forced through the grounds, one small cup in twenty seconds.

falafel.name: Falafel
falafel.desc: Soak and grind the beans, bind with flour, fry into balls.

farinata.desc: Whisk flour and water thin, pour in a tray, oil and bake.

feijoada.name: Feijoada
feijoada.desc: Slow-cook meat and beans with spice until the broth thickens.

fish_and_chips.desc: Coat the seafood, fry until it puffs, serve beside fries.

flat_white.name: Flat White

focaccia.name: Focaccia
focaccia.desc: Spread the dough, dimple it, oil and spice, then bake.

french_omelette.name: French Omelette
french_omelette.desc: Beat the eggs, melt butter, push into a roll over low heat.

french_onion_soup.name: French Onion Soup
french_onion_soup.desc: Caramelise sliced onions, add stock, top with bread and cheese, grill.

french_toast.name: French Toast
french_toast.desc: Soak in egg and milk, fry both sides.

fried_chicken.name: Fried Chicken
fried_chicken.desc: Coat the meat, fry till gold, lift and drain.

fried_dough.name: Fried Dough
fried_dough.desc: Let the dough rise, tear into pieces, fry golden.

fried_egg.name: Fry an Egg
fried_egg.desc: The oil shimmers, the egg goes in, the edge speaks first.

fried_noodles.name: Fried Noodles
fried_noodles.desc: Half-cook the noodles, then fry hard with greens.

fried_rice.name: Fried Rice
fried_rice.desc: Day-old rice is best; scramble the egg first, then toss it all.

fries.name: Fries
fries.desc: Cut the potatoes, soak off the starch, fry until the edges brown.

fruit_salad.name: Fruit Salad
fruit_salad.desc: Cube the fruit, fold in cream, chill a while.

fufu.name: Fufu
fufu.desc: Boil the cassava, pound it hot into a ball.

garlic_toast.name: Garlic Toast
garlic_toast.desc: Butter and crushed garlic, spread and baked.

gazpacho.name: Gazpacho
gazpacho.desc: Blend tomato with oil, then chill.

greek_salad.name: Greek Salad
greek_salad.desc: Chop the vegetables, top with cheese, oil and spice.

green_curry.name: Green Curry
green_curry.desc: Boil coconut milk, add spice and meat, reduce until thick.

green_papaya_salad.name: Shredded Veggie Salad
green_papaya_salad.desc: Shred the greens, pound with spice, scatter nuts.

grilled_cheese.name: Grilled Cheese
grilled_cheese.desc: Toast and cheese, buttered, fried gold on both sides.

grind_bean.name: Grind Coffee
grind_bean.desc: The sound of the grinder arrives before the aroma.

groundnut_stew.name: Groundnut Stew
groundnut_stew.desc: Stew meat and greens soft, then stir in nut paste.

ham_cheese_sandwich.name: Ham & Cheese Sandwich
ham_cheese_sandwich.desc: Ham and cheese between toast, pressed.

hamburger.name: Hamburger
hamburger.desc: Bun split, patty fried, a leaf of lettuce, then pressed down.

hash_brown.desc: Dry shreds pressed into a cake and browned.

hash_browns.name: Hash Browns
hash_browns.desc: Shred the potato, squeeze dry, press into cakes and fry both sides.

hot_cocoa.name: Hot Cocoa
hot_cocoa.desc: Milk, cocoa and sugar over low heat, stirred until dark.

hot_dog.name: Hot Dog
hot_dog.desc: Fry the sausage until the skin splits, tuck it in a roll, add tomato.

hummus.name: Hummus
hummus.desc: Boil the beans soft, blend with spice, finish with oil.

iced_americano.name: Iced Americano
iced_americano.desc: Dilute: espresso and cold water, two cubes of ice, the glass going cold.

iced_latte.name: Iced Latte
iced_latte.desc: Chill: cold milk first, espresso poured over, glass fogging up.

injera.desc: Ferment: thin flour batter rested till bubbly, spread thin and griddled.

juice.name: Juice

khao_soi.name: Khao Soi

kimchi_soup.name: Kimchi Soup

lasagna.name: Lasagna

latte.hint: Some say that once milk enters an espresso, the bitterness steps back a little.

lemonade.name: Lemonade

mac_cheese.name: Mac and Cheese
mac_cheese.desc: Boil the pasta, fold with cheese and milk, bake until browned.

macaron.name: Macaron

macchiato.name: Macchiato

make_dough.name: Make Dough

mango_lassi.name: Mango Lassi

mango_sticky_rice.name: Mango Sticky Rice
mango_sticky_rice.desc: Steam the rice, stir through coconut milk, serve with sliced fruit.

mapo_tofu.name: Mapo Tofu

mashed_potato.name: Mashed Potato
mashed_potato.desc: Boil and crush the potato, stir in milk and butter.

meat_sauce.name: Cook Meat Sauce

meat_soup.name: Meat Soup
meat_soup.desc: Meat sliced thin, blanched in rolling broth until the color deepens.

dark_chocolate.name: Dark Chocolate

milk_chocolate.name: Milk Chocolate
milk_chocolate.desc: Melt: cocoa, fresh milk, butter and sugar over water, poured and cooled.

milk_tea.name: Milk Tea

milkshake.name: Milkshake

mint_tea.name: Mint Tea
mint_tea.desc: Boil water with spice and sugar, pour high into the glass.

mocha.name: Mocha
mocha.desc: Stir: espresso, milk and dark chocolate stirred till the colour deepens.

mooncake.name: Mooncake
mooncake.desc: Press dough into a mould, brush egg, bake.

muffin.name: Muffin
muffin.desc: Fold milk, butter and sugar into the batter, fill the cups, bake until domed and cracked.

mushroom_risotto.name: Mushroom Risotto
mushroom_risotto.desc: Stir rice with mushroom and white sauce, finish with cheese.

mushroom_soup.name: Mushroom Soup
mushroom_soup.desc: Browned mushrooms, white sauce and milk.

naan.name: Naan
naan.desc: Roll the dough and bake hot until it spots.

nachos.name: Nachos
nachos.desc: Spread chips with cheese and spice, bake until melted.

nasi_goreng.name: Nasi Goreng
nasi_goreng.desc: Fry cold rice with meat and spice, top with a fried egg.

nasi_lemak.name: Nasi Lemak
nasi_lemak.desc: Soak the rice, steam it in coconut milk, serve with chilli.

noodle.name: Roll Out Noodles
noodle.desc: Roll the dough out, fold, cut, and shake loose.

noodle_soup.name: Noodle Soup
noodle_soup.desc: Noodles boiled separately, broth on its own; combine at the end so nothing goes soft.
noodle_soup.hint: Boil the noodles on their own; keep the broth separate.

onigiri.name: Onigiri
onigiri.desc: Wet your hands, shape the rice into a triangle, hide a little filling inside.

onion_rings.name: Onion Rings
onion_rings.desc: Slice onion into rings, coat in batter, fry until they float.

onion_soup.name: Onion Soup
onion_soup.desc: Fry sliced onion soft, add stock, simmer till it darkens.

onion_tart.name: Onion Tart
onion_tart.desc: Press dough into a tin, top with soft onions and cheese, bake.

oyakodon.name: Oyakodon
oyakodon.desc: Simmer meat and scallion, pour egg over, slide onto rice while loose.

pad_thai.name: Pad Thai
pad_thai.desc: Soak the noodles, then fry hard with prawns, egg and greens.

paella.name: Paella
paella.desc: Spread rice and seafood in the pan, season, simmer until dry.

palak_paneer.name: Palak Paneer
palak_paneer.desc: Boil and blend the greens, season, fold in cheese cubes.

pancake.name: Pancake
pancake.desc: Ladle batter into a pan, turn it when bubbles pop, brown both sides.

pasta_tomato.name: Tomato Pasta
pasta_tomato.desc: Boil the pasta, toss it through softened tomato.

peanut_butter.name: Peanut Butter
peanut_butter.desc: Ground peanuts, oil rising on its own.

pbj_sandwich.name: Make a PB&J
pbj_sandwich.desc: Spread: peanut butter on one slice, jam on the other, press them together.

persian_stew.name: Persian Stew
persian_stew.desc: Stew meat and beans, add greens and spice near the end.

peruvian_chicken.name: Peruvian Chicken
peruvian_chicken.desc: Marinate in spice and fruit juice, roast until the skin crisps.

pho.name: Pho

pilaf.name: Pilaf
pilaf.desc: Soak the rice, fry with meat and spice, steam with water.

pita.name: Pita
pita.desc: Bake: dough rolled round, baked hot till it puffs.

pizza.name: Pizza
pizza.desc: Stretch the dough, spread tomato, scatter cheese, bake till the rim blisters.

poached_egg.name: Poached Egg
poached_egg.desc: Poach: water just under a boil, a pinch of salt, egg slid in.

popcorn.name: Popcorn
popcorn.desc: Corn into a hot pot, lid on, until the popping thins.

potato_salad.name: Potato Salad
potato_salad.desc: Potato and egg crushed into dressing.

pour_over.name: Drip a Slow Pour-over
pour_over.desc: Water circles the grounds and you have to let it fall through on its own.

poutine.name: Poutine
poutine.desc: Fry the potatoes crisp, pour gravy and white sauce, add meat.

raita.name: Raita

ramen.name: Ramen

ravioli.name: Ravioli

red_curry.name: Red Curry

ribs.name: Ribs

rice_cake.name: Rice Cake
rice_cake.desc: Rice slurry into a mold, steamed until a chopstick lifts it whole.

roast_bean.name: Roast Coffee Beans
roast_bean.desc: Green beans into the pan, low heat, keep them moving until the color deepens.

roast_chicken.name: Roast Chicken
roast_chicken.desc: Roast: spice and butter rubbed in, roasted till the skin is gold and the juices run clear.

roasted_corn.name: Roasted Corn

roasted_vegetables.name: Roasted Vegetables

rose_dessert.name: Rose Dessert

samosa.name: Samosa
samosa.desc: Wrap potato filling in pastry, crimp into triangles, fry.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.desc: Two slices, egg and greens between, pressed and cut.

satay.name: Satay
satay.desc: Marinate and skewer the meat, grill, serve with nut sauce.

sausage.name: Sausage
sausage.desc: Meat ground, salted and spiced, then into the casing.

sausage_sauerkraut.name: Sausage & Sauerkraut
sausage_sauerkraut.desc: Shred the cabbage, rub it with salt and spice, then simmer with sausage until sour and savoury.

scallion_noodle.name: Scallion Noodles
scallion_noodle.desc: Scallions fried low, oil tossed through noodles.

scone.name: Scone
scone.desc: Baked until it splits along the seam.
scone.hint: Rub the butter into the dough, but don't work it long.

scrambled_egg.name: Scrambled Eggs
scrambled_egg.desc: Eggs into butter, pushed into soft curds.

seafood_pancake.name: Seafood Pancake
seafood_pancake.desc: Fold seafood into batter, fry flat until both sides catch.

sesame_bun.name: Sesame Bun
sesame_bun.desc: Roll dough with oil, flatten, top with sesame, bake.

shawarma.name: Shawarma
shawarma.desc: Warm the bread, layer meat and greens, sauce, roll tight.

shepherd_pie.name: Shepherd's Pie
shepherd_pie.desc: Fry meat and vegetables into a filling, top with mash, bake till golden.

shumai.name: Shumai

soda.name: Soda
soda.desc: Pour: sweet fruit water chilled, poured over ice, bubbling up.

souffle.name: Soufflé
souffle.desc: Fold yolk custard into whipped whites, bake in a ramekin until it rises.

soy_rice.name: Soy Sauce Rice

sparkling_water.name: Sparkling Water

spring_roll.name: Spring Roll
spring_roll.desc: Wrap the filling tight, fry golden.

stew.name: Stew

sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.desc: Shape warm rice, drape fish over it, add a sliver of greens.

syrup.name: Syrup

taco.name: Taco

tamale.name: Tamale
tamale.desc: Wrap meat in corn dough and leaves, then steam through.

tamarind_sauce.name: Tamarind Sauce
tamarind_sauce.desc: Simmer: fruit simmered with water, strained, sweetened and reduced.

tandoori_chicken.name: Tandoori Chicken

tangyuan.name: Tangyuan
tangyuan.desc: Roll dough into balls, boil until they rise.

tea_rice.desc: Rice in a bowl, hot tea poured over, a little greens.

tempura.name: Tempura

thali.name: Thali

tiramisu.name: Tiramisu

vienna_coffee.name: Vienna Coffee

yogurt_soup.name: Yogurt Soup
yogurt_soup.desc: Stir yogurt, flour and spice over low heat until thick.

shaved_ice.desc: Shave the ice, pour syrup over.

fruit_ice_cream.name: Fruit Ice Cream

tomato_egg_stirfry.desc: Tomato fried to juice, egg slid in.

yu_xiang_pork.desc: Velvet the pork; pickled chili meets sweet vinegar.

dan_dan_noodles.desc: Noodles bowled; pork, chili and peanuts piled on.

dry_pot_cabbage.name: Dry-pot Cabbage

steamed_chili_fish.name: Steamed Fish Head with Chili
steamed_chili_fish.desc: Cover the fish with chopped chili and steam it through.

kimchi_fried_rice.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
kimchi_fried_rice.desc: Fry chopped kimchi, then rice and egg.

dak_galbi.name: Spicy Chicken and Rice
dak_galbi.desc: Sear the chicken, then chili and rice.

pad_kra_pow.name: Pad Kra Pao
pad_kra_pow.desc: Beef and chili over high heat, on rice, under a fried egg.

lemon_chili_chicken.name: Roast Chicken with Lemon and Chili
lemon_chili_chicken.desc: Rub the skin with chili and oil, roast crisp, squeeze lemon over.

paprikash.desc: Stew chicken and onion soft; chili and cream turn it pink.

nashville_hot_chicken.name: Nashville Hot Chicken
nashville_hot_chicken.desc: Pour chili-butter oil over fried chicken.

chili_con_carne.desc: Brown the beef; stew tomato, beans and chili down thick.

elote.desc: Char the corn; smear cream and cheese, dust with chili.

doro_wat.name: Doro Wat
doro_wat.desc: Cook onions dark; add chili and chicken; bury the eggs in.

peri_peri_chicken.name: Peri-Peri Chicken
peri_peri_chicken.desc: Turn chicken in chili oil until the skin curls.

suya.name: Suya
suya.desc: Rub thin beef with chili and groundnut spice; grill to dry edges.

chili_dog.name: Chili Dog
chili_dog.desc: Fry the sausage, bread it, cover with chili and cheese.

cheese.name: Make Cheese
cheese.desc: Milk and salt heated until it curdles, then pressed dry.

butter.name: Churn Butter
butter.desc: Cream with a pinch of salt, worked until smooth.

yogurt.name: Make Yogurt
yogurt.desc: Milk and sugar, stirred and left to set.

rice_noodle.name: Press Rice Noodles
rice_noodle.desc: Rice and water ground to a slurry, steamed and pressed into strands.

nian_gao.name: Pound Rice Cakes
nian_gao.desc: Pound hot rice until no grain is left.

miso_soup.name: Make Miso Soup

tofu_dengaku.name: Grill Tofu Dengaku
tofu_dengaku.desc: Thick tofu grilled until fragrant, brushed with miso thinned by sugar.

miso_ramen.name: Cook Miso Ramen
miso_ramen.desc: Clear noodle soup finished with miso, egg and scallion added last.

fried_rice_noodle.name: Fry Rice Noodles

tteokbokki.name: Simmer Tteokbokki

di_san_xian.name: Three Treasures of the Earth

scallion_pancake.name: Scallion Pancake

liangpi.name: Liangpi
liangpi.desc: Steam the batter thin, cut into strips, dress with chili oil.

rules.name: Research Desk Rules
rules.desc: The price of trial and error: the smoother the desk, the less gets burnt.

room.subtitle: A room lived in for a long time
room.body:
The table is bolted to the floor.
A stove, a window, a lamp that never quite gets bright — that's all of it.
You cook here, and you wait here for morning. A shelf runs along the wall, every flavor you've written down kept up there.
room.hint: The room you're standing in right now.
room.name: The Room

nearby.subtitle: The little patch outside the window
nearby.body:
Someone walks past, stops at the window, and hands in a note of what they'd like to eat.
The paper is folded, the writing hurried.
They put it down and leave, as if handing you a small errand.
nearby.hint: The knocking at the window usually comes from here.
nearby.name: The Doorway

cafe.subtitle: An old food truck that ran for many years
cafe.body:
Turning around at the rear, I finally saw the whole of it: an old food truck.
Back at the door, I wiped the dust from the inside and four words came clear — OFF THE EATEN PATH.
An old little plaque is nailed up beside it, with the route it used to run.
The room you have lived in all along was this truck.
cafe.hint: The four words wiped out of the dust inside the door.
cafe.name: Off the Eaten Path
cafe.desc: What this truck used to be called.

east_asia.subtitle: Stalls open before dawn
east_asia.body:
Before the sky is light, the stalls are already out.
Dough twists turn in the oil, soy milk steams white.
More people press their faces to the window than yesterday.
east_asia.name: The Eastern Morning Market

southeast_asia.subtitle: An alley where the rain comes and goes
southeast_asia.body:
The rain comes in waves.
At the mouth of the alley a charcoal stove is set up, leaf-wrapped things slowly cooking.
The air is sweet, and it is spicy.
southeast_asia.name: The Alley by the Rainforest

south_asia.subtitle: A shop that weighs colors by the spoon
south_asia.body:
The shop is heaped with colors, weighed out spoon by spoon.
The owner says every color has to go into the pot together.
You write the order down.
south_asia.name: The Spice Shop Afternoon
south_asia.desc: Here a flavor only counts when it's complete.

middle_east.subtitle: Too hot by day, awake at night
middle_east.body:
The day is too hot; the night market only wakes at dusk.
The fires under the flatbreads line up like stars on the ground.
People weave between the stalls with tea in their hands.
middle_east.name: The Desert Night Market
middle_east.desc: The later it gets, the brighter it is.

mediterranean.subtitle: A coast that eats slowly
mediterranean.body:
The white walls glare in the sun; the sea wind comes through from the far end of the alley.
The olive oil on the table is new, the bread still warm.
People here eat slowly.
mediterranean.name: White Walls and Sea Wind
mediterranean.desc: Slow down, and the flavor comes out.

western.subtitle: Snow at the top, sugar in the doorway
western.body:
Snow on the peak, the town below.
Chimneys smoke, and butter and sugar drift out of the doorways.
Not many people pass by, but they all stop.
western.name: A Town Below the Snowline

americas.subtitle: One road, all the way to the end
americas.body:
A road runs straight until it ends at a gas station.
Burgers hiss on the griddle, coffee stays warm in the pot.
Headlights come from far off, and go past.
americas.name: The Gas Station at the End of the Road
americas.desc: Everyone on the road stops here once.

africa.subtitle: A pot that stewed all day
africa.body:
The earth is red, the fire is charcoal.
The pot is propped on stones, stewing all day long.
Anyone passing holds out a hand for a bowl.
africa.name: Red Earth and Charcoal Fire

fast_food.subtitle: You only queue after dark
fast_food.body:
The sky goes dark and the neon comes on.
The window hands out one hot thing after another, the paper bags printed with a smiling face.
The line never gets shorter.
fast_food.name: The Window Under the Neon

mailbox.name: Drop Box
mailbox.desc: A delivery crate by the door. Salt, sugar and coffee beans land inside, no signature needed.

farm.name: Farm Plot
farm.desc: A patch behind the house. Whatever you plant, it grows — slowly.

orchard.name: Orchard
orchard.desc: A few trees. More fruit falls than gets picked.

sea.name: Seafood Spot
sea.desc: A stone ledge by the water. What bites depends on luck.

ranch.name: Ranch
ranch.desc: Meat, eggs and milk behind the fence. Whether you get a pail or a basket depends on who cooperates.
